title: Short-form Video Editor
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

BKG is a home-renovation group in the Netherlands. Our brands include  (bathrooms) and

 (tiles), alongside 25+ other home-improvement brands in the wider BKG group. We film a lot of

short-form video ourselves and need an editor who turns that footage into videos people watch to the end.



JOB DESCRIPTION

You turn raw footage into Reels, TikToks and Shorts: a strong first two seconds, tight pacing, accurate captions

and light motion, in a consistent look per brand. One filming session of an hour should become 20 or more

clips. You work from the shoot guide and brief of our creative strategist, and our AI content creator supplies the

B-roll and visuals that were not filmed. Most of our videos are in Dutch; a Dutch colleague checks the captions

before anything is published. 



MAJOR FUNCTIONS

Cut each filming session into 20 or more vertical clips, following the shoot guide: choose the moments, build

the hook, cut the dead air.

Edit for retention: the strongest moment first, tight pacing, and B-roll, zooms and on-screen text where they

help.

Add captions in our brand style, accurate and well timed. For Dutch videos you work with auto-transcription

and a glossary of our terms, and a Dutch colleague checks the captions before publishing.

Build and maintain the look per brand: caption template, title and lower-third animations, colors and export

presets.

Deliver versions: per platform (length, safe zones, cover frame) and ad variants with different hooks for our

Meta ads specialist.

Handle mixed footage: phone, pocket camera, 360° (reframing) and drone. Clean up the sound and match

the color.

Keep delivery reliable: an agreed delivery day per batch, clear file names, an organized archive and a B-roll

library. One round of feedback should be enough.



REQUIRED SKILLS

2+ years of short-form editing, with a portfolio you can link to.

BKG · Vacature 9 van 10 · Short-form Video Editor / Motion · 2 oktober 2026 1 / 4

A professional editor of your own (DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro or Final Cut) next to CapCut. CapCut or

Canva alone is not enough for this role.

Strong pacing and hooks: you know what the first two seconds must do, and you can explain your choices.

Captions that are accurate, readable and timed to the speaker, and a clear process for captions in a

language you don’t speak.

Motion basics: animated titles, callouts and reusable templates.

Fast with AI-assisted tools (auto-captions, auto-clipping), and you know when to fix things by hand.

Clean sound, and you know which music a business account is allowed to use.

A computer that handles 4K footage and an internet connection that handles large files.

Reliable and responsive on your working days. Good written English.



TOOLS WE USE

Tell us which ones you have worked with.

CapCut, Submagic and Opus Clip: we provide these.

Your own DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro or Final Cut. After Effects is a plus.

Insta360 Studio for reframing 360° footage.

Canva for cover frames.

A shared drive for footage; Bitrix24 for briefs and feedback.



NICE TO HAVE

Experience editing Dutch or other foreign-language video.

After Effects and motion templates.

Sound design and color grading.

Long-form YouTube or podcast editing.

Home, interior or real-estate content.

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY

Part-time, 20 hours per week, spread over at least four days, with daily responsiveness on those days. We

agree on a delivery day for each batch of footage. You have a weekly check-in with our content team during

Amsterdam business hours (CET/CEST), which is afternoon and evening in the Philippines. A reliable, highspeed internet connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS

You turn footage around quickly without dropping quality: tight pacing, clean captions, an on-brand finish. You

follow the brief, you say so when footage is unusable, and you can tell us why you made a cut. If you spot a

way to improve a process, a tool or a result, you raise it with your manager.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY

$398/month. Part-time now, with room to grow as our content output scales. Long-term, stable role.



BONUSES

Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second

monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word “KEYFRAME” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these

four questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:

1. Name two short-form videos you edited and give the two links. A link to a folder or a full portfolio does not

count. For each: what you received (raw footage, brief) and what you did yourself.

2. Pick one of the two. Name one specific choice you made, with the timestamp (a cut, a caption timing, a

motion element), and why. Then name one thing you would do differently today.

BKG · Vacature 9 van 10 · Short-form Video Editor / Motion · 2 oktober 2026 2 / 4

3. Most of our videos are in Dutch and you don’t speak Dutch. How do you cut on meaning and get the

captions right? Give your steps, and say where a Dutch colleague comes in.

4. You receive one hour of raw footage from a single filming session, plus a shoot guide. We want 20 clips.

Describe your workflow and tools from download to delivery, and how many working hours you need.

Also include:

Your editing software and whether you have your own license, your computer (processor, RAM, graphics

card) and your internet speed.

Your usual turnaround for one 30 to 60 second short from raw footage, and which days and hours

(Philippine time) you are available.

We read every application that starts with the codeword and answers the questions specifically. Generic or

copy-paste replies aren’t considered.

title: Technical SEO Specialist
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

BKG is a home-renovation group in the Netherlands. Our brands include  (bathrooms) and

(tiles), alongside 25+ other home-improvement brands in the wider BKG group. Our websites rank

in Google today and bring in our leads, and we are rebuilding them on one platform.



JOB DESCRIPTION

You are the technical SEO for the whole group. We are moving our brand websites onto one WordPress

Multisite built with Elementor Pro: 13 brand sites to start, growing to 25+. Each new site replaces a live site that

ranks today, so your first responsibility is that we keep those rankings when we switch. Beyond that you keep

all sites crawlable, fast and well-structured, with fixes that work for every brand at once. You work with our

WordPress developer, who builds what needs code, and with our SEO lead, who owns the content strategy.

Your time is split between the wider BKG group



MAJOR FUNCTIONS

Audit the current live sites and the new templates: crawling and indexation, Core Web Vitals, structured data,

site architecture and internal linking. Deliver a fix list prioritized by impact and effort.

Set the technical SEO requirements for our design system before it is rolled out to all brands: heading

structure, URL structure, schema, canonicals and internal linking.

Own the SEO side of every brand launch: URL inventory, redirect map, pre-launch checks, and daily Search

Console monitoring in the first two weeks after the switch.

Write the SEO part of our Brand Launch Playbook, so every next launch follows the same checks.

Implement what you can yourself in WordPress (Rank Math settings, redirects, schema, sitemaps) and brief

our developer on the rest.

Keep our sites readable for AI search as well (AEO/GEO): structured data, clean content structure and crawl

access for AI crawlers.

Monitor Search Console across all properties and report monthly: what changed, what it did, and what

comes next.



REQUIRED SKILLS

3+ years of technical SEO, including larger or multi-site setups.

Proven experience with site migrations or relaunches: URL inventory, 301 redirect mapping, checks before

and after launch, and fixing what goes wrong.



Strong on crawling and indexation: robots.txt, canonicals, sitemaps, noindex, pagination and duplicate

content.

Strong on Core Web Vitals: you read the data (Search Console, PageSpeed Insights, field data) and tell a

developer exactly what to fix.

Structured data: you write and validate JSON-LD, for example Organization, LocalBusiness, Service, FAQ,

Article and Breadcrumb.

Hands-on in WordPress: you work in an SEO plugin (Rank Math or Yoast) and understand what a page

builder does to markup and speed.

You prioritize by impact and effort, not by checklist, and look for the fix that helps all sites at once.

Clear written English: audits and briefs a developer can act on without a call.



TOOLS WE USE

Experience with these is a plus. Tell us which ones you have worked with.

Google Search Console and GA4.

Ahrefs or Semrush.

Rank Math on a WordPress Multisite with Elementor Pro.

A crawler such as Screaming Frog. Tell us whether you have your own license.

PageSpeed Insights and Lighthouse; Looker Studio for reporting.

Cloudflare.



NICE TO HAVE

Experience getting content cited in AI answers (AEO/GEO).

Log-file analysis.

Search Console API or Looker Studio dashboards across many properties.

WooCommerce SEO.

Experience with the Dutch or Belgian market; knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY

Part-time, about 14 hours per week, flexible. You meet with our Dutch colleagues during Amsterdam business

hours (CET/CEST), which is afternoon and evening in the Philippines. Around a brand launch you are available

on launch day and you check Search Console daily for the two weeks after. A reliable, high-speed internet

connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS

You think at the scale of 25 sites on one Multisite: you look for the fix that lifts everything, and you sort by

impact and effort rather than running down a generic checklist. You say so when something will hurt rankings,

even if it delays a launch.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY

$223/month. Part-time now, with room to grow as more brands go live. Long-term, stable role.



BONUSES

Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second

monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word “CANONICAL” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these

four questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:

1. Describe one technical SEO problem you fixed on a large or multi-site setup: the issue, what you did, and the

result in numbers.

2. We are moving 13 live sites, one by one, onto a new WordPress Multisite: same domains, new templates and

partly new URLs. What do you do before, during and after a switch so the rankings survive? Name your

checks, not just the steps.

3. All our brand sites are built from one set of Elementor templates. Name two or three technical SEO decisions

you would want built into those templates once, so every site benefits.

4. You get Search Console access to a site you have never seen and you have one hour. What do you look at

first, and what would make you raise an alarm?

Also include:

A link to one audit, migration plan or report you made. Remove client names if you need to. Only share what

already exists; please don’t build anything for this.

The tools you work with and whether you have your own licenses, and which hours (Philippine time) you are

available for meetings with our Dutch team.

We read every application that starts with the codeword and answers the questions specifically. Generic or

copy-paste replies aren’t considered.

title: Part-Time Recruiting Coordinator / Hiring VA — U.S. Property Management
description:
We’re a growing U.S. property management company seeking an organized, proactive Recruiting Coordinator to manage our hiring pipeline for onsite teams.



You’ll help us hire maintenance technicians, property managers, leasing staff, and other property operations employees. Your job is to find qualified candidates, screen them carefully, and coordinate interviews with the appropriate hiring manager.



We need someone who can actively source talent, assess qualifications, and keep the hiring process moving.



What You’ll Do



Work with hiring managers to understand each opening, required qualifications, pay range, location, and schedule.



Create and manage job postings on approved recruiting platforms.



Actively source candidates, including for smaller towns and harder-to-fill maintenance positions.



Review applications and résumés against each role’s requirements.



Conduct initial phone or video screenings to assess relevant experience, communication, interest, pay expectations, availability, and ability to work at the property.



For maintenance roles, screen for relevant hands-on experience and required certifications using criteria provided by the hiring manager.



Present a shortlist of qualified candidates with concise screening notes, strengths, and any gaps requiring follow-up.



Coordinate interviews between top candidates and the appropriate manager.



Send reminders, confirm attendance, and follow up with candidates and managers after interviews.



Keep candidates informed and maintain accurate records throughout the process.



Coordinate reference checks and other approved pre-employment steps as directed.



Provide a weekly update on open roles, qualified candidates, scheduled interviews, and hiring bottlenecks.



What You Bring



At least two years of recruiting, talent sourcing, or hiring coordination experience.



Experience recruiting for U.S.-based employers.



Strong spoken and written English, including confidence conducting screening calls.



Experience using job boards, LinkedIn, applicant tracking systems, and spreadsheets.



Strong organization and follow-through across multiple openings.



Good judgment when evaluating candidates against defined job requirements.



The ability to handle applicant information confidentially.



Reliable internet, a computer, and a quiet space for calls.



Availability for screening calls and interview coordination during agreed U.S. Central business hours.



Preferred experience:



Recruiting for property management, multifamily housing, maintenance, construction, or skilled trades.



Filling positions in smaller towns or rural markets.



Using Indeed and finding candidates beyond incoming applications.



What Success Looks Like



Hiring managers receive qualified candidates with clear screening notes.



Candidates understand the role, location, schedule, and compensation before manager interviews.



Interviews are scheduled promptly, with consistent follow-up.



Hiring records are current, and stalled decisions are flagged early.



Your work reduces the time managers spend sorting applications and coordinating interviews.



Hiring managers will make final hiring decisions. You will own sourcing, initial screening, and coordination.



How to Apply



Please include:



Your résumé and a brief summary of your recruiting experience.



The U.S. roles you’ve recruited for, including any maintenance or property management positions.



The recruiting platforms you’ve used and how you find candidates beyond job postings.



Your availability in U.S. Central Time, weekly capacity, and expected hourly rate.



A brief response to this scenario: You need to fill a maintenance technician position in a small Illinois town, but the job posting has produced few qualified applicants. What would you do next?



Please use “Recruiting Coordinator — Property Management” as your application subject line.

title: AI Automation Expert
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

BKG is a home-renovation group in the Netherlands. Our brands include (bathrooms) and

 (tiles), alongside 25+ other home-improvement brands in the wider BKG group. We are building an

AI-first operation and want a hands-on automation expert to help run it.



JOB DESCRIPTION

You design, build and maintain the automations behind our content, SEO and lead handling. The core is a

status-driven content pipeline that runs for several brands at once, from keyword research to an approved post

on WordPress. Next to that you build our lead and CRM flows in Bitrix24, including AI reply suggestions in

Dutch that get better from won/lost outcomes. Nothing goes live without human approval, and you build that in

from the start. Your work spans the whole BKG group



MAJOR FUNCTIONS

Build and run our content pipeline in 
 for several brands: keyword research, AI draft, SEO scoring

and revision, human approval, WordPress publishing and repurposing.

Keep it status-driven: a Google Sheets control sheet where each step reliably triggers the next.

Build the AI steps on the Claude API: system prompts that hold our brand voice, return structured JSON and

follow strict content rules. Example: customer reviews are quoted word for word and never invented.

Build lead and approval flows with Bitrix24 webhooks, such as approve/reject buttons that write back to the

automation, plus AI reply suggestions for our Dutch team.

Monitor, troubleshoot and document: error handling, usage costs, and handover material that non-technical

colleagues can use.



REQUIRED SKILLS

Proven hands-on experience building production workflows in 
: scenarios, routers, filters,

repeaters/loops, scheduling, error handling and keeping operations (credits) usage efficient.

Able to design status-driven, multi-stage pipelines where each step triggers the next reliably.

Strong working knowledge of REST APIs: HTTP requests, headers, authentication (API keys, OAuth 2.0,

application passwords), JSON parsing and mapping.

Experience setting up inbound and outbound webhooks, and with asynchronous API patterns: starting a job,

waiting, then fetching and handling results.



Hands-on experience calling the Anthropic Claude API (or a similar LLM API) directly, with strong prompt

engineering: consistent brand voice, reliable structured JSON, strict content rules.

Able to build iterative AI loops, such as draft → score → revise → re-score, with sensible stop conditions and

cost control.

Experience automating WordPress through its REST API (drafts, posts, categories, tags, application

passwords) and comfortable using Google Sheets as a control layer (structured data, data validation,

lookups).

Solid understanding of SEO fundamentals, so the automation improves rankings rather than just producing

more content.

Quality and security: you build in human-in-the-loop checkpoints, handle credentials and API keys securely,

resolve authentication, formatting and rate-limit issues on your own, and write clear documentation.

Fluent spoken and written English. You can explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical team

members.



TOOLS WE USE

Experience with these is a strong plus. We don’t expect you to know all of them; tell us which ones you have

worked with.

SEMrush: keyword research, Keyword Gap, Content Gap, and the API/MCP options on different plans.

NeuronWriter or similar SERP-based content optimization tools (Surfer, Clearscope), including their APIs and

content scoring.

Google Search Console: property verification, performance data (clicks, impressions, average position) and

pulling that data through the API.

Bitrix24: inbound and outbound webhooks and approval flows.

MCP (Model Context Protocol) for connecting AI tools to external data sources such as SEMrush.

Google reviews through review aggregators (Trustmary, EmbedSocial, Elfsight) and/or the Google Business

Profile API.



NICE TO HAVE

Experience running automations for multiple brands or websites at once.

Experience tracking and optimizing API and usage costs.

Basic scripting (JavaScript or Python) for edge cases that no-code tools can’t handle.

Experience with content repurposing workflows (blog to LinkedIn, Instagram and newsletter).

Experience with n8n.

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY

Full-time, 40 hours per week. You meet regularly with our Dutch colleagues during Amsterdam business hours

(CET/CEST), which is afternoon and evening in the Philippines. Flexible otherwise. A reliable, high-speed

internet connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS

You take ownership and work independently: you don’t wait to be told what to do next. If you spot a way to

improve a process, a tool or a result, you raise it with your manager. You build systems that produce Dutch

output you can’t read yourself, so approval steps and quality safeguards matter to you.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY

$1,275/month, with room to grow for the right person. Long-term, stable role.



BONUSES

Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second

monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.





HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word “SCENARIO” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these four

questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:

1. Describe one 
 scenario you built that runs in production: what triggers it, the main modules and

routers, how errors are handled, and roughly how many operations (credits) it uses per run or per month.

2. Describe one automation where you called an LLM API (Claude or similar) directly. How did you get valid

JSON back every time, and how do you stop the model from making things up? For example: we quote

customer reviews word for word and never invent them.

3. We want a content pipeline where an article is drafted by AI, scored by an SEO tool, revised and re-scored,

and published to WordPress only after a human approves it. How would you structure this: which stages or

statuses, where the approval sits, and what stops the revise loop from running forever or burning budget?

4. Give one example of an integration that was asynchronous (start a job, wait, fetch the result) or that kept

failing (authentication, rate limits, formatting). What exactly did you do?

Also include:

Links to two automations you have built: one in 
 and one using an AI/LLM API. Screenshots, a

blueprint export or a short screen recording are fine. Only share what already exists; please don’t build

anything for this.

Which of the tools under “Tools we use” you have worked with, and which hours (Philippine time) you are

available for meetings with our Dutch team.

We read every application that starts with the codeword and answers the questions specifically. Generic or

copy-paste replies aren’t considered.

title: WordPress Multisite Developer
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW



BKG is a home-renovation group in the Netherlands. Our brands include  (bathrooms) and  (tiles), alongside 25+ other home-improvement brands in the wider BKG group. Our websites bring in the leads the whole group runs on.



JOB DESCRIPTION



You build and maintain the websites of the BKG group. We are bringing our brand sites together on one WordPress Multisite built with Elementor Pro: 13 brand sites to start, growing to 25+. Your first job is the design system that every brand site is built from. After that you build and launch brand after brand, while the current live sites keep running until each new one is ready. About a fifth of your time goes to the website of our bathroom brand. You think about all sites at once, not one at a time.



MAJOR FUNCTIONS



Build our Elementor design system on the Multisite: design tokens (colors, typography, spacing), about 12 reusable components and 5 page templates, with a mobile Lighthouse score of 85 or higher.

Build brand sites from that system (8 to 10 pages each), so a change is made once and each brand keeps its own logo, colors and name.

Launch each brand on its real domain together with our SEO specialist: redirect mapping, domain mapping, SSL, Cloudflare, sitemap and Search Console checks after launch.

Connect lead forms (Gravity Forms) to our CRM (Bitrix24) and automations through webhooks, and build the tracking basis (data layer, tags) into the templates.

Keep the network healthy: tested updates, backups, security and Core Web Vitals across all sites.

Maintain and improve the Sanitairstudio website: templates, speed, mobile and lead forms (about 8 hours a week).

Document what you build so colleagues can maintain it. Later on: WooCommerce shops.



REQUIRED SKILLS



3+ years of professional WordPress development, including hands-on work on a Multisite network (subdomains, domain mapping) or a comparable multi-brand setup you can show.

Strong in Elementor Pro: Theme Builder, global colors and fonts, reusable templates and components, dynamic tags, custom CSS.

Able to design a system where a change is made once and reaches every site, while each brand keeps its own identity.

Solid PHP, HTML, CSS and [removed] custom functions, hooks, shortcodes or a small plugin when Elementor alone isn’t the right tool.

Performance optimization with measurable Core Web Vitals results (LCP, INP, CLS): caching, images, fonts, scripts and lean Elementor builds.

Site launches and migrations without losing rankings: 301 redirect mapping, domain mapping, SSL, DNS basics and checks after launch.

Forms and integrations: lead forms that reliably deliver to a CRM through webhooks or an API, plus tracking events for analytics (Google Tag Manager, data layer).

A safe way of working on live sites: staging, backups, tested plugin updates, rollback, and careful handling of credentials.

Clear documentation, and fluent spoken and written English.



TOOLS WE USE



This is our stack. Elementor Pro is required; experience with the rest is a plus. Tell us which ones you have worked with.



Hello Elementor theme with Elementor Pro and ElementsKit.

Gravity Forms for lead forms.

Rank Math for SEO, and a redirect manager for migrations.

BerqWP, Redis object cache and Cloudflare for performance.

WordPress REST API and application passwords: our content automation creates drafts through the API.

Bitrix24 (CRM) and 
 on the receiving end of form webhooks.



NICE TO HAVE



WooCommerce: we will add shops later.

Experience with 10 or more sites on one network.

Experience moving a Multisite from shared hosting to managed WordPress hosting.

WP-CLI and Git.

Technical SEO basics: schema markup, canonical and indexing settings.

A good eye for design details and accessibility basics (WCAG).

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY



Full-time, 40 hours per week. You meet regularly with our Dutch colleagues during Amsterdam business hours (CET/CEST), which is afternoon and evening in the Philippines. Flexible otherwise. A reliable, high-speed internet connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS



One source, many brands: you build reusable systems instead of one-off pages. You keep performance and consistency front of mind, you test before you touch a live site, and you document what you build. If you spot a way to improve a process, a tool or a result, you raise it with your manager.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY



$637/month, with room to grow for the right person. Long-term, stable role.



BONUSES



Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word “NETWORK” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these four questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:



Describe one Multisite or multi-brand WordPress project you built: how many sites, which page builder, what was shared across the sites and what was set per site.

We build with Elementor Pro on a Multisite. A shared header component changes. How do you get that change onto every brand site while each brand keeps its own logo, colors and name? Tell us what you would build once and what stays per site.

Give one concrete example of improving Core Web Vitals on an Elementor site: the numbers before and after, and the two or three changes that made the difference.

You launch a rebuilt site on its real domain, replacing a live site that ranks in Google and brings in leads. What are your steps before, during and after the switch so rankings and leads survive?



Also include:



Links to two sites you built, at least one of them on a Multisite or part of a multi-brand setup, with a short note on your part in each. Only share what already exists; please don’t build anything for this.

Which of the tools under “Tools we use” you have worked with, and which hours (Philippine time) you are available for meetings with our Dutch team.

title: Funnel Builder
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW



BKG is a home-renovation group in the Netherlands. Our brands include (bathrooms) and  (tiles), alongside 25+ other home-improvement brands in the wider BKG group. Most of our websites generate leads: the goal is a showroom appointment or a request for advice, not an online sale.



JOB DESCRIPTION



You turn website visitors into leads and showroom appointments. For each offer, such as our inspiration book, a free 3D bathroom design, a style quiz or a price calculator, you build the whole route: landing page, form, thank-you page and the step to an appointment. You build it yourself in WordPress with Elementor Pro and Gravity Forms, you measure every step, and you improve it with tests. About a third of your time goes to our bathroom brand. The rest goes to the lead funnels of the other brand sites in the group, which we are bringing together on one WordPress Multisite. Our pages are in Dutch: the copy comes from our Dutch team, and you own the structure, the build and the numbers.



MAJOR FUNCTIONS



Start with a baseline: measure the routes we already have (appointment form, inspiration book, free 3D design), so every change can be compared with what was there before.

Build complete lead funnels per offer in WordPress with Elementor Pro: landing page, opt-in form, thank-you page and the next step to a showroom appointment or a request for advice.

Build the forms in Gravity Forms: short on a phone, multi-step where it helps, with conditional logic and calculations (for example a bathroom price calculator), and a few questions that tell our sales team how serious the lead is.

Make sure every lead arrives: together with our WordPress developer and our AI automation expert you send each form entry to our CRM (Bitrix24) with its source (UTM), trigger the follow-up, and test the whole route end to end.

Improve on data: one hypothesis at a time, A/B tests where there is enough traffic, bigger changes (offer, headline, form length) where there is not. Write down the conclusion of every test and report monthly: visitors, leads, appointments and what you will change next.

Deliver landing pages for our ad campaigns and opt-in forms for our
 flows, matched to the ad or
 the visitor comes from.

Set the conversion requirements for the landing-page template and form component in our design system, and turn what works into templates every brand can reuse.



REQUIRED SKILLS



2+ years building lead-generation funnels and landing pages, with conversion numbers you can show.

You build in WordPress with Elementor Pro yourself: landing pages, pop-ups and thank-you pages, mobile-first and fast. Experience in ClickFunnels or GoHighLevel alone is not enough for this role.

Strong in a WordPress form builder, ideally Gravity Forms: multi-step forms, conditional logic, calculations, hidden fields, notifications and webhooks.

A CRO way of working: hypothesis, test, conclusion. You know when a test has too little data to conclude anything, and what to do then.

Landing-page structure: one goal per page, the same message as the ad, a clear offer, proof, and a form that is no longer than it needs to be.

Basic conversion tracking you can set up yourself: GA4 events and Google Tag Manager, form-submit or thank-you-page conversions, UTM parameters.

Careful work on live pages: you test on mobile and desktop, submit every form route yourself, and check that the lead reaches the CRM.

Clear written English. You can explain a test result to non-technical colleagues.



TOOLS WE USE



This is our stack. Elementor Pro is required; experience with the rest is a plus. Tell us which ones you have worked with.



WordPress Multisite with the Hello Elementor theme, Elementor Pro and ElementsKit.

Gravity Forms; MetForm on our current Sanitairstudio site.

GA4, Google Tag Manager and Looker Studio.

Bitrix24 (CRM, including WhatsApp follow-up) and 
 on the receiving end of the forms.

Meta Ads: pixel and conversion events on landing pages.

A/B-testing and behavior tools (a split-test plugin, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar). Tell us what you use.



NICE TO HAVE



High-ticket local services (renovation, kitchens, solar) where a conversion is an appointment.

Calculators or quizzes built as lead magnets.

Appointment-booking tools and calendar integrations.

Landing-page copywriting, and experience working with copy in a language you don’t speak.

EU privacy rules (GDPR): consent on forms, cookie consent and what it does to your tracking.

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY



Part-time, about 12 hours per week, flexible. You meet with our Dutch colleagues during Amsterdam business hours (CET/CEST), which is afternoon and evening in the Philippines. When a campaign has a start date, the landing page is live and tested before that date. A reliable, high-speed internet connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS



You care about what happens after the click: a lead that never reaches our sales team is worth nothing, and ten serious leads are worth more than fifty weak ones. You d
 on numbers, and you say so when there is too little data to d
. You work with Dutch text you can’t read yourself, so nothing goes live before a Dutch colleague has checked it. If you spot a way to improve a process, a tool or a result, you raise it with your manager.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY



$239/month. Part-time now, with room to grow as more brands go live. Long-term, stable role.



BONUSES



Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word “VARIANT” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these four questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:



Describe one lead-generation funnel you built yourself: the offer, the pages and the form, the tool you built it in, and the numbers (visitors, leads, conversion rate) before and after your work.

Describe one test you ran on a page or a form: your hypothesis, what you changed, how many visitors it had and how long it ran, and what you concluded. A new landing page of ours may get only a few hundred visitors a month. What does that change about how you test?

A new bathroom is a big purchase that people think about for months. A visitor asks for our free inspiration book. What do you build on the page, in the form and after the form, so that the serious visitors end up with a showroom appointment?

A form entry has to reach our CRM, trigger a confirmation
 and count as a conversion in GA4 and Meta. How do you set that up, and how do you check that no lead gets lost?



Also include:



Links to two landing pages or funnels you built, at least one of them in WordPress with Elementor, with a short note on your part and the conversion rate if you know it. Screenshots are fine if a page is no longer live. Only share what already exists; please don’t build anything for this.

Which of the tools under “Tools we use” you have worked with, and which hours (Philippine time) you are available for meetings with our Dutch team.



We read every application that starts with the codeword and answers the questions specifically. Generic or copy-paste replies aren’t considered.

title: Remote Bookkeeper – 2 Positions Available (Philippines)
description:
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

Employment Type: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Location: Philippines

Number of Openings: 2

Start Date: Immediately



About the Role

We are a Canadian accounting firm seeking two reliable and detail-oriented Bookkeepers based in the Philippines to support our bookkeeping and accounting operations remotely.



The ideal candidates will have strong experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO) and Microsoft Excel, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while managing multiple client accounts.



Responsibilities

- Maintain accurate bookkeeping records for multiple Canadian clients using QuickBooks Online (QBO).

- Record and categorize daily financial transactions, including income, expenses, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.

- Perform bank and credit card reconciliations.

- Prepare and maintain Excel working papers, including account reconciliations and supporting schedules.

- Review financial transactions and identify missing, duplicate, or incorrectly recorded entries.

- Assist with GST/HST calculations, reconciliations, and reporting.

- Prepare adjusting journal entries and assist with month-end and year-end bookkeeping.

- Organize and maintain financial records and supporting documentation.

- Communicate with the accounting team regarding discrepancies and outstanding information.

- Maintain confidentiality of client financial information.



Requirements

- Previous bookkeeping experience is required.

- Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and Microsoft Excel is required.

- Experience with Excel formulas, including SUMIF, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and PivotTables.

- Good understanding of bookkeeping principles, journal entries, and account reconciliations.

- Ability to work accurately with large volumes of financial transactions.

- Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

- Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

- Experience working with Canadian accounting firms or Canadian clients is an asset.

- Knowledge of Canadian GST/HST and payroll is an asset.



How to Apply

Please submit the following:

- Your résumé.

- A brief summary of your bookkeeping experience, particularly with Canadian clients, if applicable.

- Details of your experience with QuickBooks Online and Microsoft Excel.

- A list of other accounting software you have used.

- Your expected monthly compensation in PHP.

- Your earliest available start date and preferred working hours.



Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a practical bookkeeping assessment using sample QuickBooks Online and Excel data.

title: Analytics & Tracking Specialist

JOB DESCRIPTION

You make sure that everything that matters is measured, and that the numbers can be trusted. We are bringing

our brand websites together on one WordPress Multisite: 13 brand sites to start, growing to 25+. You design the

measurement once, so it works for every brand: which events we track, how they reach GA4, Meta and Google

Ads, and how the visitor’s consent is respected. Then you turn the data into one dashboard per brand that our

team leads steer by. About a third of your time goes to our bathroom brand and a small part to

Write the measurement plan: one set of events, parameters and names for all brands (form submit, phone

and WhatsApp click, appointment request, download), and which of them count as conversions.

Specify the data layer for our design system, so our WordPress developer builds it into the templates once,

Set up GA4 per brand plus a group view, and connect the ad platforms: Meta Pixel and Conversions API with

deduplication, and Google Ads conversions.

Keep it compliant in the EU: a consent banner with Google Consent Mode v2, tags that respect the visitor’s

choice, and no personal data in analytics.

Follow leads past the form: with our automation expert, pass the source of each lead (UTM, click IDs) into

our CRM (Bitrix24), so we see which channel brings appointments and sales, not just form fills.

Build a Looker Studio dashboard per brand and one for the group, send a short monthly report, and check

every month that analytics, form entries and CRM still match. Fix double counting and whatever broke.'

2+ years of hands-on tracking work with GA4 and Google Tag Manager, on more than one website.

Google Tag Manager in depth: data layer events, triggers and variables, lookup tables, workspaces and

versions, Preview mode.

BKG · Vacature 5 van 10 · Analytics & Tracking Specialist · 2 oktober 2026 1 / 4

GA4 in depth: events and key events, custom dimensions, cross-domain measurement, internal-traffic

Meta Pixel and Conversions API: server events, deduplication with event IDs, and reading the diagnostics in

Consent for EU visitors: Google Consent Mode v2 with a consent management platform. You know what may

Lead-generation tracking: forms, phone and chat clicks, and UTM and click IDs passed through hidden form

You write a measurement plan others can follow, document what you set up, and check your own work: test

GA4, Google Tag Manager and Google Search Console.

Looker Studio, with GA4, Search Console and Google Sheets as data sources.

Google Ads conversion tracking, and Merchant Center for our tile webshop.

WordPress Multisite with Elementor Pro and Gravity Forms.

Bitrix24 (CRM) and 
.

Server-side Google Tag Manager.

Offline conversions: sending CRM outcomes (qualified lead, sale) back to Meta and Google Ads.

Getting ad and CRM data into dashboards without paid connectors (Google Sheets, 
, APIs).

E-commerce tracking in GA4 (purchases, Google Shopping).

Tags for Pinterest and TikTok; Microsoft Clarity.

BigQuery or SQL.

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY

Part-time, about 6 hours per week on average. The first weeks are setup and take more hours; after that it is

during Amsterdam business hours (CET/CEST), which is afternoon and evening in the Philippines. When a site

1. Describe one tracking setup you built for a lead-generation website: which conversions you tracked (forms,

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
About
 Maven

 Maven is a boutique
 marketing agency serving associations and nonprofits across the United States. We help communications and marketing teams improve their
 strategy, deliverability, and member engagement. Our clients are mid-to-large associations — professional societies, trade groups, and member organizations.

This is a small, focused agency led by the founder. You will work directly with me and have real visibility into client work, marketing, and business growth from day one.



About This Role

I am a solopreneur running a growing boutique agency. My 3 person team is dedicated entirely to client work, which means I need a highly capable virtual assistant to support me directly across sales, marketing, and operations.

Your primary focus is managing my inbox and sales support. I attend conferences, speak at events, and generate leads — and I need someone to help me follow up fast, keep prospects warm, and move deals forward in HubSpot while I focus on relationships and strategy. Marketing is the second priority: it feeds the pipeline, so consistency matters.

You should be comfortable working independently, communicating clearly in English, and using AI tools — including Claude and ChatGPT — to produce high-quality work efficiently. You do not need to create strategy; you need to execute it excellently.



What You Will Do

1. Inbox Support 

As a busy entrepreneur I need help managing my inbox — flagging priority messages, drafting responses for my review, and eventually handling routine communications independently.



2. Sales & HubSpot CRM

This is the most important part of the role. I need someone who will keep the sales engine running when I am busy serving clients, speaking at events, or traveling.

- Keep HubSpot CRM up to date at all times — contacts, deal stages, notes, and follow-up tasks after every call or conference

-When I return from a conference, help me execute the follow-up process quickly — entering contacts, sending outreach
s, and moving leads into the pipeline

-Research prospects ahead of conferences and events — identify who will be attending, flag high-fit contacts, and prep outreach so I am ready before I walk in the door

-Follow up with potential clients on my behalf — send check-in
s, schedule calls, and keep deals moving so nothing falls through the cracks

-Build and manage lead nurture
 campaigns in HubSpot to keep prospects warm between touchpoints

-When a contract is signed, execute my client onboarding process: prepare the Statement of Work (SOW) and hand off to my team so they can get started



3. Speaking & Conference Support

-Track upcoming conference speaking application deadlines for the associations industry

-Send me reminders in advance so I never miss a submission window

-Help me submit speaking applications — gather the required details, draft the submission, and manage the process

-Build PowerPoint presentations for confirmed speaking engagements using my outlines and existing branded templates



4. Content & Social Media Marketing

Marketing feeds the sales pipeline. Your job is to keep
 Maven showing up consistently so that prospects already know who I am before I reach out.

-Use my existing PowerPoints, documents, and presentations to write high-quality long-form blog content (bonus skill — helpful but not required from day one)



5. Monthly Newsletter

-Ensure both versions are consistent, on-brand, and go out on schedule



6. AI Tools & Automation

-Use Claude and ChatGPT daily to draft content, do research, and speed up repetitive tasks

-Build and maintain simple AI agents or automated workflows to support agency operations

-Proactively suggest ways AI tools can improve our processes and save time





What We Are Looking For

Required

• Strong written English — you will be writing sales outreach and content that represents my brand publicly

• Experience managing an inbox 

• Experience with HubSpot CRM and/or Marketing Hub — keeping pipelines clean and campaigns running

• Comfortable doing prospect research and writing professional outreach
s

• Experience with Canva for creating on-brand graphics and formatted content

• Hands-on experience with AI tools — Claude, ChatGPT, or similar — including building basic automations or agents

• Comfortable posting and engaging on LinkedIn and Instagram

• Organized and self-directed — able to juggle a content calendar, CRM tasks, and follow-ups without being micromanaged

• Reliable internet connection and consistent availability during US Eastern Time hours



Nice to Have

• Experience with Wix website editing and blog publishing

• Background in writing for associations, nonprofits, or membership organizations

• Experience building or managing lead nurture campaigns

• Experience supporting a founder or solopreneur in a sales or business development capacity

title: Local SEO Specialist
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW



BKG is a home-renovation group in the Netherlands. Our brands include  (bathrooms) and  (tiles), alongside 25+ other home-improvement brands in the wider BKG group. Customers visit our showroom before they buy, so being found on Google Maps matters to us.



JOB DESCRIPTION



You make our physical locations easy to find and easy to choose in Google Maps and local search. You keep our Google Business Profiles complete and active, make our business details consistent across the web, help us earn and answer reviews, and track how we rank in the towns around us. You follow the playbook of our SEO lead and you stay inside Google’s guidelines: real locations, real names, real reviews. About a third of your time goes; the rest goes to the other locations of the BKG group.



MAJOR FUNCTIONS



Start with an audit: every profile and listing that exists for our addresses and brand names (Google, Apple Maps, Bing and Dutch directories), who owns it, and what is wrong, double or outdated.

Keep our Google Business Profiles complete and current: categories, services, products, opening hours (including holidays), appointment link, photos and videos.

Make name, address and phone number (NAP) consistent everywhere: fix wrong listings first, then add the directories that matter in the Netherlands.

Post weekly on each profile, with photos and news from our showroom and content team.

Reviews: help our store team ask every customer for a review in an honest way, draft a reply to every review, and report fake ones. Replies and posts are in Dutch: you draft them with our templates and AI, and a Dutch colleague checks them before they go live.

Track local rankings for a fixed set of searches and towns, and report monthly: profile views, calls, direction requests, website clicks, reviews, and what you will do next.

Ask before you change a business name, address, phone number or main category, and keep a log of every change you make.



REQUIRED SKILLS



1+ year managing Google Business Profiles for real shops, showrooms or local service companies, with results you can show.

You know Google’s guidelines for representing a business and you stay inside them: real names without added keywords, real addresses, one profile per real business.

Citation work: you can audit and clean up name, address and phone number across directories, and you choose relevant listings over large numbers.

Review management within the rules: no bought, traded or self-written reviews, and no asking only happy customers.

You can read a profile’s performance data and a local rank tracker, and report in plain numbers.

Careful and consistent. This is steady weekly work, and one wrong edit can get a profile suspended.

Comfortable working in a language you don’t speak: templates, AI drafts, and nothing public without a native check.

Good written English.



TOOLS WE USE



Experience with these is a plus. Tell us which ones you have worked with.



Google Business Profile (manager access) and Google Maps.

Apple Business Connect and Bing Places.

Semrush or Ahrefs, and Google Search Console.

A local rank tracker or citation tool, such as BrightLocal, Whitespark or Local Falcon. Tell us what you use.

Canva for post images.

Claude and DeepL for Dutch drafts; Bitrix24 for tasks.



NICE TO HAVE



Experience with several locations or brands at once.

Experience with a rebrand, a duplicate or merge request, or getting a suspended profile reinstated.

Experience with European or Dutch directories.

Basics of LocalBusiness schema and location pages.

360° photos or virtual tours on a profile.

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY



Part-time, about 6 hours per week, spread over at least two days so reviews don’t wait a full week. You meet with our SEO lead during Amsterdam business hours (CET/CEST), which is afternoon and evening in the Philippines. A reliable, high-speed internet connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS



You keep our listings accurate without being chased. You would rather ask than guess when an edit could put a profile at risk, and you never let unchecked Dutch go live. If you spot a way to improve a process, a tool or a result, you raise it with your manager.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY



$60/month. Part-time now, with room to grow within our findability team. Long-term, stable role.



BONUSES



Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word “PROXIMITY” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these four questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:



Describe one Google Business Profile you managed for a real shop, showroom or local service: what you changed in the first month, and what happened to calls, direction requests or rankings. Give numbers.

Two of our brands share one building: a bathroom showroom and a tile store. What do you check before d
 whether they get one Google Business Profile or two, and what would you never do to make them rank?

A competitor has far more Google reviews than we do, and a manager asks you for 50 new reviews this month. What do you do, and what do you refuse to do?

You don’t speak Dutch. A customer leaves a 2-star review in Dutch on our profile. Walk us through what you do, step by step.



Also include:



The public Google Maps links of one or two profiles you manage or have managed, with a short note on your part. Only share what already exists; please don’t build anything for this.

Which of the tools under “Tools we use” you have worked with, and which days and hours (Philippine time) you are available.



We read every application that starts with the codeword and answers the questions specifically. Generic or copy-paste replies aren’t considered.

title: Content Writer
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW



BKG is a home-renovation group in the Netherlands. Our brands include (bathrooms) and  (tiles), alongside 25+ other home-improvement brands in the wider BKG group. People research a new bathroom for months before they buy, and we want to be the source they find and trust.



JOB DESCRIPTION



You make sure our articles rank in Google and get quoted in AI answers (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity). Our market is Dutch, and you don’t need to speak Dutch: you do the research, the structure and the AI-assisted draft, and a Dutch editor checks every article before it goes live. You work from the keyword strategy and briefing template of our SEO lead, in a content pipeline with two approval gates: she approves the calendar before you draft, and the draft before it is published. Half of your time goes to our bathroom brand; the other half to the wider BKG group. We start with two sites.



MAJOR FUNCTIONS



Research what Dutch homeowners actually ask: Semrush (Dutch database), Search Console, “People also ask”, and the questions in our own
 communities and showroom. Turn our SEO lead’s keyword clusters into outlines.

Draft with AI inside our content pipeline (Claude, an SEO scoring tool, WordPress drafts): you write the brief and the prompts, and you edit the draft until it is accurate, useful and on brief.

Structure every article for search and for AI answers: a direct answer first, question headings, short paragraphs, lists and tables, an FAQ, internal links and a clear next step for the reader.

Keep the facts straight: every fact, price and quote traces back to a source or to our own team. Customer reviews are quoted word for word. Nothing is invented.

Hand over each draft in WordPress with notes for the Dutch editor, process the corrections, and keep a list of recurring corrections so the next draft is better.

Update what we already have: use Search Console to find articles that rank on page two or have gone stale, and improve those before writing new ones.

Keep the content calendar up to date and report monthly: what was published or updated, rankings, clicks, and where we were cited in AI answers.



REQUIRED SKILLS



2+ years of SEO content work with results you can show: rankings, traffic, or articles cited in AI answers.

You understand search intent and structure: you can turn a keyword cluster into an outline that answers the question first.

You know how AI answers pick their sources (AEO/GEO): direct answers, clear entities, original facts and well-structured pages.

An AI writing workflow of your own, and the editing skill to make an AI draft accurate and specific instead of generic.

Fact discipline: you check claims, keep a source list, and never let an invented fact, price or quote through.

Keyword research in Semrush or Ahrefs, and Google Search Console for finding what to update.

WordPress basics: drafts, headings, internal links, images with alt text, and the fields of an SEO plugin.

Comfortable producing content in a language you don’t speak, with a native editor checking every draft.

Excellent written English.



TOOLS WE USE



Experience with these is a plus. Tell us which ones you have worked with.



Claude for drafting, in a pipeline built on 
 and Google Sheets.

Semrush or Ahrefs, and Google Search Console.

A content-scoring tool such as NeuronWriter or Surfer.

WordPress with Rank Math.

DeepL and a grammar checker for back-translation and checks.

Bitrix24 for tasks and approvals.



NICE TO HAVE



Knowledge of Dutch or German: a big plus.

Experience writing for a non-English market through AI and a native editor.

Home-improvement, interior or construction topics.

FAQ and HowTo schema; featured snippets you have won.

Refreshing and pruning old content.

Experience with a status-driven content pipeline (sheet, draft, approval, publish).



AVAILABILITY



Part-time, 20 hours per week, flexible. You have a weekly review with our SEO lead during Amsterdam business hours (CET/CEST), which is afternoon and evening in the Philippines. A reliable, high-speed internet connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS



Useful and correct beats long and fast. You never invent a fact, a price or a quote, and you flag what you could not verify. You expect your Dutch drafts to be corrected, and you learn from every correction. If you spot a way to improve a process, a tool or a result, you raise it with your manager.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY



$319/month. Part-time now, with room to grow as more sites are added. Long-term, stable role.



BONUSES



Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word “SNIPPET” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these four questions in 3 to 6 sentences each; question 2 asks for exactly two:



Share one article you wrote or edited that ranks or gets cited: the target keyword, what you did yourself and what AI did, and the result in numbers (position, clicks, or an AI answer that cites it). Add the link.

One of our articles is titled “Open vs. closed bathroom layouts: the pros and cons”. Write the first two sentences of that article, in English, so that they answer the question directly and could be quoted by an AI assistant.

Our articles are published in Dutch and you don’t speak Dutch: you work with AI, and a Dutch editor checks every draft. Walk us through your process from brief to draft. How do you make sure the Dutch text says what you intended, and that no fact, price or quote is invented?

Topic: making the most of a small bathroom. Where would you find out what Dutch homeowners actually ask about this, and which three questions must the article answer first?

Which of the tools under “Tools we use” you have worked with, and which hours (Philippine time) you are available for a weekly review with our Dutch team.

title: Junior Salesforce Developer
description:
We are seeking a Junior Salesforce Developer to help build and scale a Salesforce ecosystem supporting our rapidly growing organization. This position will work directly with the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to deliver solutions across Salesforce Field Service, MuleSoft integrations, reporting and analytics, automation, and custom user experiences.

This is a hands-on role focused on executing a product roadmap through a combination of Salesforce declarative capabilities and targeted custom development. The ideal candidate understands when to leverage platform configuration and when custom code is truly warranted.

The successful candidate will participate in architecture discussions, own approved development efforts, manage deployments, and contribute to the long-term scalability of our Salesforce platform.

This position requires alignment with U.S. business hours, Monday through Friday.



Key Responsibilities

Salesforce Administration & Configuration

• Design and build custom objects, fields, record types, page layouts, and Lightning pages.

• Develop and maintain Validation Rules, Formula Fields, Custom Metadata Types, and other declarative solutions.

• Create and maintain Reports and Dashboards to support operational and executive decision-making.

• Configure and support Salesforce Field Service functionality.

• Troubleshoot user-reported issues and platform defects.

• Maintain platform quality and consistency through established governance and change management processes.

Automation & Process Improvement

• Design, build, test, and deploy Salesforce Flows, including: 

o Record-Triggered Flows

o Scheduled Flows

o Screen Flows

• Identify opportunities to improve business processes through automation.

• Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with platform best practices.

Development

• Develop Lightning Web Components (LWC) to support custom user experiences when declarative solutions are insufficient.

• Build and maintain Apex classes, triggers, and supporting frameworks when necessary.

• Participate in solution design discussions and contribute technical recommendations.

• Follow established development standards, documentation requirements, and coding best practices.

Integrations

• Support Salesforce integrations with enterprise applications through MuleSoft.

• Assist with API design, testing, troubleshooting, and validation.

• Work with REST-based services and modern authentication patterns.

• Collaborate with integration stakeholders to ensure data quality and reliability.

Release Management & DevOps

• Build, test, and deploy approved enhancements through Sandbox and Production environments.

• Participate in release planning, testing, and production deployment activities.

• Contribute to source control and CI/CD practices as they are implemented.

• Maintain technical documentation and deployment records.

Required Qualifications

• Salesforce Certified Administrator credential.

• Salesforce Platform Developer I credential.

• 1-3 years of Salesforce administration and/or development experience.

• Experience building and supporting: 

o Custom Objects

o Fields

o Validation Rules

o Formula Fields

o Lightning Record Pages

o Reports and Dashboards

o Salesforce Flows

• Experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC).

• Basic experience with Apex development.

• Understanding of Salesforce security concepts, including: 

o Profiles

o Permission Sets

o Role Hierarchy

o Sharing and Visibility

• Experience working with REST APIs.

• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work during U.S. business hours, Monday through Friday.



Preferred Qualifications

• Salesforce Business Analyst Certification.

• Salesforce Platform App Builder Certification.

• MuleSoft Associate or MuleSoft Developer Certification.

• Experience supporting Salesforce Field Service.

• Experience with enterprise system integrations.

• Familiarity with: 

o GitHub

o Git-based source control

o DevOps Center

o Gearset

o Copado

o CI/CD deployment practices

• Experience working in Agile software delivery environments.

• Experience documenting business processes, technical solutions, and user-facing functionality.



What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate:

• Embraces a configuration-first mindset.

• Understands when to use declarative tools and when custom code is appropriate.

• Delivers high-quality solutions with minimal technical debt.

• Operates effectively within established governance and change-control processes.

• Collaborates constructively in architecture and design discussions.

• Produces clear, maintainable, and well-documented solutions.

• Contributes to a scalable Salesforce ecosystem capable of supporting significant organizational growth.



Our Development Philosophy

We believe in Configuration Before Customization.

Our preferred approach is to leverage Salesforce's native platform capabilities, including Flows, Validation Rules, Formula Fields, Lightning App Builder, Dynamic Forms, Reports, Dashboards, and Custom Metadata wherever practical. Custom development should be reserved for scenarios where business requirements cannot reasonably be met through declarative solutions.

We are building a scalable Salesforce and MuleSoft ecosystem designed for long-term growth and maintainability. Successful candidates will share a commitment to sound architecture, disciplined delivery practices, continuous improvement, and reducing unnecessary complexity.

title: US Healthcare Recruiter (Full-Time, Remote) — US Pediatric Home Health Company
description:
About Home Heart Florida

Home Heart Florida is a US pediatric home health agency. Our nurses care for medically complex children in their own homes, so the families we serve can keep their kids out of the hospital. We are a small, high-trust team hiring directly, with no agencies.



The Role

You will recruit registered nurses (RNs) and licensed practical nurses (LPNs) in Florida for children who are waiting for care. You will call and screen new applicants the same day they apply, book interviews, follow up with anyone who goes quiet, keep every candidate up to date in our applicant system, and work closely with our HR Director and our scheduling team so that every open case gets the right nurse as quickly as possible.



What You'll Do

- Call and screen new nurse applicants every day, usually within hours of them applying

- Book interviews and chase no-shows until they are re-booked or closed out

- Keep every candidate in the right stage in Greenhouse, with a clear next step

- Reach out to nurses who have not applied yet and convince them to talk to us

- Run reference checks and hand hired nurses over to onboarding

- Track your own numbers every week and work to improve them



What We're Looking For

- At least 2 years as a recruiter, personally running screening calls and moving candidates to a hire

- Clear, confident spoken and written English, and comfort on the phone all day

- Proven ability to keep 50 or more active candidates moving at once without anyone falling through the cracks

- Persistence and warmth: you follow up until you get an answer, and nurses enjoy talking to you



Preferred (not required)

- Recruiting for US nurses or other healthcare roles

- Home health or pediatric recruiting

- Experience with Greenhouse, Indeed, LinkedIn Recruiter, Bullhorn or a similar system

- Spanish



Technical Requirements

- Reliable computer and stable internet of at least 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload

- Backup power or internet, or another plan for outages

- A quiet, professional place to take calls



Compensation & Setup

- Full-time, long-term role, direct hire (no agency)

- Training provided

- Compensation: $1,200 USD per month

- Working hours: 8 AM to 5 PM US Eastern (Miami time), which is 9 PM to 6 AM Manila time (8 PM to 5 AM until US clocks change on 11/1/26), Monday to Friday

Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be reviewed, including applications sent through the OnlineJobs.ph Apply button instead of the link above.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW



BKG is a home-renovation group in the Netherlands. Our brands include  (bathrooms) and (tiles), alongside 25+ other home-improvement brands in the wider BKG group. Our founder and our head of content film most of our videos themselves, in Dutch and in English.



JOB DESCRIPTION



You d
 what we film and how, so that our presenters only have to show up and film. From topics and product picks you make shoot packages: concept, hooks, talking points, shot list and a one-page shoot guide. One filming session should give our editor 20 or more clips. You brief our video editor and our AI content creator, you own the content calendar, and every month you use the numbers to d
 what we make more of. You direct; you don’t film or edit. A bit more than half of your time goes to the wider BKG group; the rest is split between our bathroom brand, and our tile brand. You are the working deputy of our head of content.



MAJOR FUNCTIONS



Set the content plan per brand: pillars, formats and a hook bank, based on what our customers ask and what performs.

Turn each week’s topics into shoot packages for our presenters: concept, hook options, talking points, shot list and a one-page shoot guide, ready two working days before each filming day.

Write the briefs for our video editor and our AI content creator (cuts, captions, B-roll, visuals), and review their work against the brief.

Give our Meta ads specialist angles to test: turn what works organically into ad concepts.

Own the content calendar for all brands and channels: what goes out when, and why. Our engagement specialists do the scheduling.

Evaluate every month with the numbers (hook rate, retention, saves, shares, leads): what we repeat, what we change and what we stop.

Guard the brand voice and the style guide on everything that goes out.



REQUIRED SKILLS



2+ years of concepts and scripts for short-form video (Reels, TikTok, Shorts), with results you can show: links and numbers.

A strong instinct for hooks and story: you know what has to happen in the first two seconds and what keeps people watching.

You write shoot guides that a non-professional presenter can film from without help.

You brief editors and designers clearly, and your feedback makes the next version better.

You read the numbers (hook rate, retention, saves, shares) and change the plan because of them.

You can plan: a content calendar for several brands that stays realistic for the people who film and edit.

You can work for a market whose language you don’t speak: you research Dutch content with translation tools and leave the final Dutch wording to our native presenters. For our English content you write the script yourself.

Excellent written and spoken English.



TOOLS WE USE



Experience with these is a plus. Tell us which ones you have worked with.



Instagram, TikTok,

CapCut, Submagic and Opus Clip on the editing side; Canva.

Claude for research and first drafts.

NICE TO HAVE



Home, interior, renovation or real-estate content.

Creative strategy for paid social: ad angles and hooks that were tested with budget.

Founder-led or personal-brand content.

Experience directing non-actors, on set or remotely.

Experience with European markets.

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY



Part-time, 18 hours per week. You join a weekly idea session with our founder and our head of content during Amsterdam business hours (CET/CEST), which is afternoon and evening in the Philippines. Flexible otherwise, as long as each shoot package is ready on time. A reliable, high-speed internet connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS



Our presenters should never have to invent anything on the day: every shoot is fully prepared. You think in hooks and retention, you d
 on numbers rather than taste, and you say so when an idea will not work, also when it comes from the founder. If you spot a way to improve a process, a tool or a result, you raise it with your manager.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY



$430/month, with room to grow for the right person. Long-term, stable role.



BONUSES



Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word “SHOTLIST” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these four questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:



Share two short-form videos you conceived or scripted: the link, your exact part in it, the hook, and the numbers (views, watch time or retention, saves or shares). In one sentence each: why did it work?

Our bathroom showroom has more than 70 complete bathrooms. The presenter is a colleague, not an actor, filming on a phone. Give three hooks for three different videos filmed there. For each: the first line the presenter says, and what we see in the first two seconds. No “did you know” and no “stop scrolling”.

Most of our videos are in Dutch, and one filming session of an hour should give our editor 20 or more clips. What is in your shoot package so the presenter can film without calling you, and what do you leave to the presenter?

After a month, video A has 40,000 views, 15% of viewers watch to the end, and it has 20 saves. Video B has 6,000 views, 45% watch to the end, 150 saves, and it brought in three showroom appointments. What do you make next, and what do you stop?



Also include:



One shoot guide, script or content brief you wrote for someone else to film or edit. Remove client names if you need to. Only share what already exists; please don’t build anything for this.

Which of the tools under “Tools we use” you have worked with, and which hours (Philippine time) you are available for the weekly session with our Dutch team.



We read every application that starts with the codeword and answers the questions specifically. Generic or copy-paste replies aren’t considered.

title: CaseWare Working Papers Expert – Accounting & Audit Workflows (Remote)
description:
The Opportunity:

This is a part-time specialist opportunity supporting a SaaS company working to understand the current capabilities and limitations of AI tools when interacting with professional software. They are developing realistic, safe simulations that allow AI models to attempt important software workflows while their performance is closely observed and evaluated. You will bring current, hands-on expertise in CaseWare Working Papers, Orion AdvisorTech, or AuditBoard to help ensure these workflows and simulations accurately reflect how expert users operate in real-world environments. - Help the client understand how expert users interact with the software during day-to-day work.

- Help determine appropriate ways to score and grade an AI tool attempting to assist with or perform identified workflows.

- Support the creation of safe software simulations by providing expert input on how closely simulated workflows reflect the real-world application.

- Help evaluate whether AI tool performance observed in simulations is representative of performance within real-world software.

- Collaborate regularly with internal team members while meeting agreed deadlines and maintaining a high standard of work quality.



Compensation:

Competitive monthly compensation based on experience and role scope.



Monthly compensation ranges from ₱40,000 – ₱56,000, depending on experience and role scope. Final compensation is aligned with the candidate’s experience level.



Required Skills

- For Orion AdvisorTech specialists, experience with Portfolio Accounting and/or Advisor Portfolio is of particular interest.

- Professional working English proficiency and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal team members.
