I'm the founder of a digital growth marketing company that helps mission-driven founders scale their businesses with more ease & less overwhelm - and I'm looking for a small team of highly-skilled Executive Assistants to help take over the marketing and management tasks that make a huge difference in the lives of the people that hire us.



I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company.



If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply:



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar &
 Management, etc)

You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to
 & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language



-- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify

You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software



- 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram,
, Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing

You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus



- Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)

You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-)



- Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and
 service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc)



ABOUT YOU:

- “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable.

- Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects.

- You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months.

- You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth

- You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving.

- Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday.

- You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources.

- You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for.



If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply.



PERKS:

I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in:

- Task & Calendar Management

- Launch/Sales Strategy Planning

- Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses)

- Social Media Management

- Digital Media Marketing (Including
 and SMS Marketing)

- Lead Generation



After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include:

- Part time work hours

- Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast)

- Starting Salary at $400-$500 USD a month ($4800-$6000 USD annual)

- Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn)



Interested? Please reply to this post with the secret keyword "APPLES" so I know you can pay attention to detail - from there, I'll let you know next steps if you qualify.

title: Experienced Amazon Marketplace Sales Specialist (VA)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Amazon Sales Specialist to manage and grow our business across U.S. and international Amazon marketplaces.



The ideal candidate has at least 2 years of hands-on experience with the Amazon U.S. marketplace, strong Amazon PPC skills, and a proven ability to improve sales, profitability, and listing performance.



Note: Creating listings for new products is not required. Optimizing existing listings is essential.



Responsibilities



- Manage Amazon Seller Central and develop strategies to grow sales and profitability across assigned marketplaces.

- Create, manage, and optimize PPC campaigns, including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.

- Monitor ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CPC, and conversion rates.

- Optimize existing listings through keyword research, SEO, and conversion improvements.

- Analyze competitors, sales reports, rankings, and product performance.

- Manage promotions, coupons, inventory monitoring, and account health.

- Identify growth opportunities and provide regular performance reports.



Requirements



- Minimum 2 years of experience managing the Amazon U.S. marketplace.

- Experience with international Amazon marketplaces is an advantage.

- Proven experience in Amazon PPC and sales growth.

- Strong knowledge of Amazon SEO, keyword research, competitor analysis, and listing optimization.

- Understanding of Amazon sales and advertising metrics.

- Analytical, proactive, and capable of working independently.

- Willingness to work night shifts aligned with U.S. business hours, if required.



How to Apply



Please provide the following:



1. Amazon Experience: Years of experience and marketplaces managed.

2. Sales Results: Examples of sales growth and achievements.

3. PPC Experience: Campaign experience and ACOS, TACOS, or ROAS results.

4. Sales Strategy: How you would grow an Amazon brand's sales.

5. SEO & Listing Optimization: Your experience improving existing listings.

6. Availability: Working hours, night-shift availability, and current employment status.

7. Computer & Internet: Mac or PC, dual monitors, and an internet speed test screenshot.

8. Workspace: A photo of your dedicated workspace.

9. Resume & Portfolio: Updated resume and relevant work samples or campaign results.

10. Video Introduction: A 1–2 minute video introducing yourself, your Amazon experience, key achievements, and why you're a good fit.



Important: Be honest about your experience. Applicants may be asked to demonstrate their work through Seller Central or relevant backend reports. Please redact confidential business information from any samples submitted.

title: Virtual Assistants – Prison Advocacy, Research & Outreach Projects
description:
**Seeking 3–4 Virtual Assistants for Prison-Focused Projects**



We’re looking for three or four organized, reliable assistants to support a range of prison-focused writing, research, advocacy, publishing, and outreach projects. Assistants may work across several projects, depending on their skills and interests.



Projects include:



- Researching how to obtain a TDCJ commissary contract for Black haircare products.

- Developing a plan to donate books rejected by prison mailrooms to domestic violence shelters.

- Researching costs, processes, potential partners, and advocacy steps for a 24-hour, in-cell su
 hotline button for people in solitary confinement.

- Supporting efforts to publish the children’s book *Mommy Snatchers* with Random House.

- Promoting *Ending Isolation* by arranging virtual appearances for its coauthors on podcasts, NPR, and with book clubs.

We’re especially interested in people with strong research, writing, communications, outreach, project coordination, advocacy, or animation skills. Experience with prison-related issues is helpful. Please share a little about your background, relevant experience, and which projects interest you.



Details about hours, compensation, and assignments can be discussed with interested applicants.

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines-based VAs only)



Read this whole thing before you apply. If you skim it, you'll fail step one.



Smartland manages 1,400+ rental homes and apartments. The CEO moves fast and d
 faster. This role exists to make him faster still: to remove friction, anticipate the next three steps, and never let a ball drop. You are his memory, his logic check, and his second brain.





This is not a calendar-and-coffee job. If that's what you're looking for, stop here.



What you'll actually do:



Run the CEO's day so he doesn't have to think about logistics: calendar, travel, prep, follow-through.

Catch things before they become problems. We expect you to flag what we missed.

Hold the full picture in your head: who owes what, what's due when, which thread is still open.

Turn vague direction into a finished result without being walked through it.

Build and maintain checklists for everything, because nothing falls through a good checklist.



Who we're looking for:



You think fast and you think clearly. Sloppy logic is a dealbreaker.

Your memory is sharp. People are surprised by what you remember.

You are relentlessly organized. You love checklists, genuinely, not as a line on a résumé.

You're proactive. You'd rather ask forgiveness than wait for instructions on the obvious.

You think strategically. You see why a task matters, not just what the task is.

When the standard template doesn't fit, you build a better one.



Do not apply if:



You need detailed instructions to start.

You've ever said "that's not my job."

You drop tasks and blame the volume.

You're hoping to wing it. We will find out by week one.



English Communication Requirement



Candidates must have strong English communication skills, with a minimum expected level of B2; C1 is preferred.



You should be able to communicate clearly and professionally in both written and spoken English, understand instructions accurately, and communicate effectively with clients, prospects, and internal team members.



An English proficiency test result is not required at the time of application. However, Smartland may request proof of English proficiency later in the hiring process, including after the interview, if needed.

title: Senior Bookkeeper
description:
First things first...

This is a 100% remote position that requires 0–10% travel and has a salary range of 1,700-1,900/month USD, plus 13th-month pay. This is a full-time, monthly salaried position. You will be required to work Central Standard Time business hours. 



We are looking for a seasoned accounting professional who can take ownership of daily accounting operations, confidently solve problems, and deliver accurate financials with minimal oversight. 



Does working on a variety of projects, contributing to different types of workflows, never having the same day twice in a row sound exciting to you? Are you a financial wizard with a passion for precision and a love for meaningful work? Us too.. That’s why we started Atomus Partners!



If you're ready to elevate your career in accounting, we have an exciting opportunity that awaits you!



What We Do

Atomus -- the Latin word for atoms, which are the basic building blocks of the universe. At Atomus Partners, we operate as a back-office nucleus, allowing the organization to focus on what it does best - its core business. We remove the common challenges small and medium-sized businesses often struggle with in developing, growing, and maintaining a highly functional back office (HR, Administrative, Finance/Accounting, IT), and help them to see beyond today.



What You’ll Do

Reporting to our Accounting Manager, our Senior Bookkeeper will independently manage day-to-day accounting operations, take ownership of month-end close activities, and ensure accurate, review-ready financial reporting. Your days will be filled with:



Client and Team Support:

• Independently manage accounting deliverables and collaborate with the Accounting Manager to ensure accurate financial reporting and dependable service. 

• Maintain organized files, ensure deliverables are complete and on time, and support the Accounting Manager in executing key initiatives throughout the year. 

• Work alongside cross-functional partners and external vendors to ensure smooth payroll processing, accurate reporting, and successful year-end preparation. 

• Communicate confidently and professionally with U.S.-based clients, participating in calls, proactively following up on outstanding items, and resolving routine accounting questions. 



Financial Mastery:

• Manage day-to-day activity in QuickBooks Online including transaction coding, accounts payable and receivable workflows, and maintaining clean, organized ledgers. 

• Perform bank and credit card reconciliations, review activity for accuracy, and ensure accounts are supported and properly documented. Independently prepare and post adjusting journal entries such as accruals, prepaids, deferrals, and depreciation. 



Balance Sheet Ownership:

• Own the review and reconciliation of balance sheet accounts to ensure completeness and accuracy. Identify variances or unusual patterns, independently research and resolve discrepancies, and escalate complex issues to the Accounting Manager with proposed solutions. 

• Maintain schedules and take ownership of month-end close processes, ensuring financial statements are accurate, complete, and ready for Accounting Manager review. 



Process Enhancement:

• Identify opportunities to streamline existing workflows, improve documentation, and reduce manual steps.

• Bring forward ideas and participate in projects to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability in the accounting function.



What will make you successful in this role (skills)

• Excellent English, written and verbal skills required.

• Accounting education preferred.

• Proven Expertise: With at least 5 years of full-cycle US bookkeeping experience, fully utilizing GAAP accounting, you have strong skills in financial reporting, accurate reconciliations, and independently reviewing and analyzing balance sheets and financial statements to identify and resolve discrepancies before final review. 

• Technical Proficiency: You are tech-savvy, with a minimum of 3 years of experience in QuickBooks Online and strong expertise in Excel. You skillfully navigate multiple internal systems to manage time efficiently and ensure seamless client communication, and deliverables.

• Experience with accounts payable platforms such as 
, Ramp, or Melio; experience with Xero is a plus.

• Success in leveraging task management systems to stay organized, manage deadlines, and maintain clear priorities.

• Extreme Attention to Detail: Attention to detail is so important in what we do every day. So much, that we want to make sure you read this posting in its entirety. When you submit your resume, there will be a question that says “Please include any additional information that you feel has not been previously covered”, please enter your favorite color here.

• Accounting Judgment: Strong understanding of how transactions impact the financial statements, with the ability to identify unusual balances, research discrepancies, and determine appropriate accounting treatment without step-by-step guidance. 

• Integrity and Confidentiality: Uphold the highest ethical standards, ensuring confidentiality of sensitive financial information.

• Communication Extraordinaire: Your clear and concise communication skills, both written and verbal, set the stage for effective client interactions. You are confident in communicating directly with U.S.-based professionals, asking thoughtful questions, and clearly explaining accounting matters. 

• Multi-Tasking Maven: Thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple tasks and deadlines with finesse.

• Independent Initiative: Demonstrated ability to independently manage accounting responsibilities, proactively identify and resolve issues, meet deadlines without constant follow-up, and deliver accurate, complete work with minimal oversight. 

• Collaborative Champion: Your collaborative spirit and positive attitude make you an invaluable team player.

• Continuous Improvement Advocate: Embrace change and champion process enhancements, keeping up with evolving client and organizational needs.



Why Us?

Working at Atomus Partners means living our core values: Commit to Quality, Create Solutions, Collaborate as One, Cultivate Raving Fans, and Climb Higher. You will be challenged daily to develop solutions. Atomus Partners is not for those who just want to clock in, go through the motions, and clock out, as you’ll learn more and grow in 1 year than in 3-5 years at other companies. If you share our core values and liked what you read on this job posting, please apply.



What is in store for you:

Collaborative team culture in a dynamic working environment

Medical insurance reimbursement for the employee and one dependent

20 Leave credits consumed at your discretion

Talent engagement & development programs

WFH arrangement



How to Apply:

Please submit your application here with a direct link to your CV/Resume.

Important: To demonstrate your attention to detail, please include your favorite color in the subject line of your application message.



Note: Applications without a CV link and the correct subject line will not be considered.

title: Executive Assistant to a US Business-Owner Couple | Healthcare & Real Estate | Full-Time US Eastern Hours
description:
ABOUT THIS ROLE



I'm Ken Allen, an Enrolled Agent with 26 years in US tax. I run a tax advisory firm, and I'm recruiting this role for a client.



My clients are a married couple in the US who own healthcare and real estate businesses. They are busy, successful and buried in admin. They need one sharp, trustworthy person to take it off their plate and keep it off.



You'll work for both of them. You will be contracted and paid by their company, not by my firm. I run the search and the screening. They make the final pick.



THE ROLE



You're their right hand for everything that isn't the core of their businesses.



Inbox and calendar



- Triage both inboxes. Surface what truly needs them, handle the rest

- Run two calendars that overlap: business, family and personal. Catch conflicts before they happen

- Prep them for meetings and calls with what they need to know



Banking and admin



- Call and
 banks, insurance companies, vendors and government offices on their behalf. Sit on hold so they don't have to

- Open accounts, chase paperwork, follow up until it's done

- Track subscriptions and recurring charges. Flag what they don't use and what went up



Documents and passwords



- Gather and organize documents, including what their accountant needs each year

- Keep their logins organized in a shared password manager

- Build simple trackers and checklists so nothing falls through the cracks



What you will NOT do: you will never access patient or medical records at their healthcare businesses, and you will never send or approve payments or wires. Bank access starts view-only. Trust and access grow over time.



REQUIRED



- 3+ years as an executive assistant or personal assistant to a US business owner, executive or physician

- Excellent written English. Your
s could pass for a US assistant's

- Clear, confident spoken English. You'll be on the phone with US banks and vendors

- Able to work 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern, Monday to Friday, every week

- Full-time only. This is your one job

- Experience with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, and a password manager (1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass or similar)

- Reliable internet plus backup power and backup internet



STRONG PLUS



- You've supported two bosses at once, or a couple or family

- Healthcare, medical practice or real estate background (admin side)

- You've handled US banking tasks: account openings, document requests, disputes

- You use AI tools to work faster and you check their work



WHO THRIVES HERE



- You'd rather close a loop today than send a reminder tomorrow

- You call when calling is faster

- You ask a good question instead of guessing on things that matter

- You treat private information like it's your own

- You want a long-term home. They're hiring for years, not months



PAY



- $1,000 to $1,400/month based on experience and what you show in the test task

- Paid directly by the couple's company

- Paid test task for shortlisted candidates



HOW TO APPLY



To show me you read this whole post, start your application with the exact phrase: "Off your plate." Applications without it will be skipped, no exceptions.



Then send:



1. Your resume

2. Short answers to these three questions:

- Two requests land at 9:05 AM Eastern. One owner asks you to book a dinner with friends Thursday at 7 PM. The other owner already blocked Thursday evening for both of them for a family event. Neither one is answering messages. What do you do?

- A manager at one of their healthcare businesses
s you a scanned form and asks you to save it to the owners' shared folder. You open it and it's a patient's intake form with a name and diagnosis. What do you do?

- Tell me about a time you took a messy errand off a busy boss's plate and finished it. A bank, insurance company, government office or vendor. What was it, what did you do step by step, and how long did it take?

3. A voice recording or short video, 1 to 2 minutes. Start by leaving a voi
 as if you're calling a US bank for your boss: "Hi, this is [your name], executive assistant to [boss's name]. I'm calling about..." Then introduce yourself in English.



Shortlisted candidates get a few written follow-up questions, a 15-minute video call with me, then a paid test task. The couple meets the finalists.



I read every application myself.



Ken Allen, EA

title: # 🚀 Digital Marketing & Growth Expert
description:
### Meta Ads | GoHighLevel | Lead Generation | Google Ads | Content & Sales



We are looking for an **exceptionally tech-savvy, results-driven Digital Marketing & Growth Expert** to join our growing healthcare and wellness business.



This is **not just a social media posting job**. We are looking for someone who understands how to build a complete digital marketing system—from generating leads to nurturing them, creating content, optimizing campaigns, and helping convert leads into paying customers.



If you love technology, learn new software quickly, enjoy solving problems, and are excited about AI and digital marketing, we want to hear from you!

* Generate high-quality leads and continuously improve cost per lead and conversion rates

### 💰 Sales & Lead Conversion

* Help improve lead nurturing and follow-up strategies

* Identify opportunities to increase appointment bookings and sales

## 🧠 Who We Are Looking For

* A fast learner who can quickly master new software and AI tools

## ⭐ BIG PLUS

* AI tools for marketing and content creation

## 📚 Don't Know Everything? That's Okay.

### ⭐ IMPORTANT:



Start your application with the words:



**“I AM A TECH & MARKETING PROBLEM SOLVER”**

We are looking for a **long-term team member** who wants to grow with our company, learn new technology, and help us build an exceptional digital marketing and lead-generation system.

title: Part-Time Phone Customer Support, US Agriculture App (Night Shift PH)
description:
We're Twisted Pine Cattle Co., a small company in Fort Worth, Texas. We make maiGrex, a record-keeping app for cattle ranchers. A rancher takes a photo of an animal, says the ear tag number and a short description out loud, and the app saves it to that animal's history. The app opens to the public in November 2026, and we're hiring our first phone support person.



Our customers are ranchers in Texas and across the US. Many are older, they are not tech people, and they call because they want a real person to help them. Your job is to be that person: patient, clear, and friendly.



SCHEDULE

Monday to Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. US Central time. After November 1 that is 9:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m. Philippine time. Ranchers call early, before they go out to work cattle, so this shift is the one that matters.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Answer inbound calls on our business phone line using a phone app on your computer

- Help callers download the app, sign up, log in and reset passwords

- Walk callers through using the app, step by step, using our help guide

- Take clear messages and pass account or billing questions to the founders

- Return voi
s left outside your shift

- Log every call in a simple shared tracker



IMPORTANT: maiGrex keeps records. It does not diagnose animals or give health advice, and neither will you. If a caller asks about a sick or injured animal, you tell them to contact their veterinarian. We'll train you on exactly how to say this.



WHAT WE NEED

- Excellent spoken English: clear, natural, and easy for American callers to understand

- At least 2 years of phone support experience with US customers

- Patience with callers who are not comfortable with technology

- A quiet place to work with no background noise

- A good headset with a noise-cancelling microphone

- Reliable internet and backup power or backup internet

- Comfortable working night shift Philippine time



NICE TO HAVE

- Spanish. Many ranchers in South Texas speak Spanish.

- Experience supporting a mobile app

- Any farm, ranch or rural background



HOW WE WORK

- You'll be an independent contractor working directly with the two founders

- We provide training, a help guide and a call script

- We start with a paid trial period of 2 weeks

- Long-term role for the right person. Hours can grow as we grow.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that skip these steps won't be reviewed.



1. Start your application with the word HERDLINE so we know you read this post.



2. Tell us in a few sentences about your phone support experience with US customers.



3. Record a voice clip of 2 minutes or less and include the link (Google Drive, Vocaroo or similar is fine). In the clip:

   - Read this out loud: "Thank you for calling maiGrex, this is [your name]. I can help you get the app set up. First, open the App Store on your phone. Do you have an iPhone or an Android?"

   - Then, in your own words, explain how you would help an older rancher who is frustrated because he can't log in.

   - If you speak Spanish, add a short introduction in Spanish.



Shortlisted applicants will do a live practice call with us on video.

title: AI Content Creator
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

BKG is a home-renovation group in the Netherlands. Our brands include(bathrooms) and

 (tiles), alongside 25+ other home-improvement brands in the wider BKG group. We publish a lot of

short-form content and need someone who makes everything the camera did not capture.



JOB DESCRIPTION

You make the visuals that were not filmed: images, B-roll clips, backgrounds, carousels and infographics. You

start from what is real, our showroom photos, product photos and 3D bathroom designs, and you use AI to

animate, extend and complete it. We sell real products, so a generated image is never presented as a real

customer project or a real product. You work from the briefs of our creative strategist and deliver to our video

editor and our social team. Your work covers  the wider BKG group, with the

group as the biggest share.



MAJOR FUNCTIONS

Build a prompt library and visual templates per brand (look, light, colors, typography), so everything we

publish looks like one brand.

Make the visuals that were not filmed. Start from our own photos and 3D designs (animate, extend, upscale)

and generate the rest: backgrounds, cutaways and title cards.

Deliver B-roll clips and images to our video editor in the right format, on the agreed day.

Design carousels and infographics in Canva from the briefs of our creative strategist.

Draft the captions for those posts. Dutch text is drafted with AI and our templates, and a Dutch colleague

checks it before it goes out.

Repurpose: turn one idea into several formats, such as a carousel, an infographic, a pin, an article image or

an ad creative.

Check every asset before you deliver it (hands, taps, reflections, tile lines, text), and label AI-generated

content where platforms require it. Voice or avatar work is done only with the consent of the person shown.



REQUIRED SKILLS

1+ year making content with AI image and video tools, with a portfolio.

Image generation and editing beyond the prompt: reference images, inpainting, upscaling, and placing real

products into a scene.

Image-to-video: short B-roll clips made from stills that hold up on a phone screen.

BKG · Vacature 10 van 10 · AI Content Creator · 3 oktober 2026 1 / 4

Good visual taste. You can match a brand look, and your work does not look generic.

Canva: carousels and infographics from a brand kit, with clean typography.

A sharp eye for AI mistakes, and the patience to fix them.

You know the rules: platform labels for AI content, commercial-use rights of your tools, and never showing a

generated image as a real project or product.

You work from a brief, at pace, and you keep your files and prompts organized.

Good written English.



TOOLS WE USE

We provide Krea, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Canva and Claude. Tell us which of these you know, and which other

tools you use (for example Midjourney, Flux, Runway, Kling, Photoshop or Topaz).



NICE TO HAVE

Interior, architecture or product visuals.

Photoshop: generative fill and compositing.

Basic motion in CapCut or After Effects.

Ad creatives that were tested with budget.

Experience working with 3D renders.

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY

Part-time, 22 hours per week, spread over at least four days. We agree on a delivery day for each batch. You

have a weekly check-in with our content team during Amsterdam business hours (CET/CEST), which is

afternoon and evening in the Philippines. A reliable, high-speed internet connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS

You fill the gaps the camera can’t: fast, on-brand and without hand-holding. You are honest about what is

generated: if a visual could be mistaken for a real project, you say so before it goes out. If you spot a way to

improve a process, a tool or a result, you raise it with your manager.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY

$438/month. Part-time now, with room to grow as our content output scales. Long-term, stable role.

BONUSES

Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second

monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.





HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word “INPAINT” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these four

questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:

1. Share three pieces you made with AI tools for real content, with links: one image, one video clip (B-roll or

animation) and one carousel or infographic. For each: the tools you used, and what you fixed or changed by

hand after generating.

2. We sell real bathrooms and tiles, and we have real showroom photos and 3D designs. A script needs a shot

of a finished bathroom that we never filmed. What do you make, and what would you never present as real?

3. You need ten images and five short B-roll clips that look like one brand. How do you keep the look

consistent, and which AI mistakes do you check for before you deliver?

4. From one video and its brief you make a five-slide carousel with Dutch text, a language you don’t speak.

Describe your steps, and how you prevent text mistakes on the slides.

Also include:

Your usual turnaround for a five-slide carousel and for a five-second B-roll clip. Only share work that already

exists; please don’t make anything new for this.

Which tools you have your own subscription for, and which days and hours (Philippine time) you are

available.

We read every application that starts with the codeword and answers the questions specifically. Generic or

copy-paste replies aren’t considered.

title: Cleaning Company VA: Paid Training Month, Then a Big Raise (US Maid Service Experience + American English)
description:
HOURS: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern.



PAY: The first month is a paid training month at $500. That month is how we see the quality of your work: how fast you reply, how you sound on calls, how you handle clients and cleaners. If it's working, you get a substantial raise after the first month, to $1,000+/month for the right person, and it keeps going up as we grow. Paid monthly through OnlineJobs.ph Easypay. Long-term, full-time, working directly with the two owners. No middle managers.



We're doing it this way because we'd rather pay a great person well than pay an okay person a little. If you're good at this, the training month is the easiest $500 you'll make and the raise is real.



TWO THINGS ARE NON-NEGOTIABLE. READ THESE FIRST.



1. You've already done this exact job for a US house cleaning company. You've worked as a VA, booker or dispatcher for a US maid service: recurring cleans, deep cleans, move-outs. Window cleaning, pressure washing, janitorial-only or Airbnb turnovers don't count. If you haven't worked for a US house cleaning company, please don't apply. We'll skip it, even if you're great at everything else.



2. You sound like you were born and raised in the United States. This is the one part we can't bend on. We're listening for one thing: would a customer in Miami who calls us assume they're talking to someone from the US? If there's any accent at all, even a light one, we won't be able to pick you. No hard feelings, and it's nothing against you or your English. If people often ask whether you grew up in the States, this job is for you.



Spanish is a big plus. A lot of our clients speak Spanish, so if you can take a call in Spanish too, tell us and show us in your voice message.



ABOUT US

We're Mark and Joey, two 19-year-old college students running Vassal Cleaning, a house cleaning company in Miami and South Florida. We book cleans for nice homes and send independent cleaners to do them. Small team, no corporate stuff, and you'd be the voice of the company. We want someone who feels like a friend on the team: chill, funny, and locks in when it counts. If you're super formal and stiff, this probably isn't for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Booking and sales (most of the job)

- Text every new lead back in under a minute, then call them. Leads come from Thumbtack, Google and our website.

- Quote from our price list (standard, deep, move-in/move-out, add-ons like inside the fridge and oven) and close the booking in our system.

- Handle "that's more than I expected," and follow up with everyone who didn't book.



Dispatch

- Match each booked clean with a cleaner in that area, and confirm both the day before and the day of.

- When a cleaner cancels at 7 AM for a 9 AM job, find a replacement fast and tell the client before they notice.



Customer service

- Reschedules, add-ons and complaints. A missed spot means booking a reclean, not arguing.

- Keep every client's notes right: gate codes, parking, pets, what they care about.



MUST HAVE

- 1+ year booking or dispatching for a US house cleaning company. Name the company, how long, how many cleaners and jobs a week.

- You've quoted cleans by bedrooms/bathrooms or square feet, and you know a standard from a deep from a move-out clean.

- You sound born and raised in the US (see #2 above). We d
 this from your voice message only.

- At your computer the whole shift, replying in under a minute. Reliable internet plus a backup, a quiet room and a good headset.



BIG PLUS

- Spanish, well enough to take a booking call

- Cleaning software: Booking Koala, ZenMaid, Launch27, Jobber, Housecall Pro, MaidCentral

- Quo/OpenPhone, Thumbtack, Angi, Yelp or Google Local Services

- You know Miami and keep up with US pop culture



HOW TO APPLY

We read every application ourselves. If it reads like ChatGPT wrote it, we skip it. Write like you'd text a friend; typos are fine. Skip a step and we won't read the rest.



1. Subject line: "Vassal Training Month - [your name] - [the US cleaning company you worked for]"

2. Your house cleaning experience in 3-4 sentences: the company, the city it served, how long, how many cleaners and jobs a week, and what software you used.

3. A 60-90 second voice message (Vocaroo, Google Drive or Loom; make sure the link opens without a login). Talk like it's a real call: a lead asks "How much for a deep clean, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, about 1,800 sq ft?" Give a price (make one up). They say "hmm, that's more than I expected." Show us what you say next. If you speak Spanish, do 20 seconds of it in Spanish at the end.

4. Two quick texts, 1-2 sentences each:

   a. A client texts that the cleaner missed the baseboards and the shower glass. What do you text back?

   b. A cleaner texts at 7 AM that she can't make her 9 AM job. What do you do first?

title: Airbnb Operations Lead
description:
We are a premier short-term rental management company that excels at delivering a luxury-grade experience for our guests. Because we hold our operations to hotel-standard cleanliness and rapid, high-touch communication, we are looking for a highly proactive, meticulous, and persistent Virtual Assistant to join our team.



In this role, you aren’t just answering messages; you are the operational heartbeat of our properties. We do not micro-manage. Instead, we empower diligent professionals who take total ownership of their shifts. Our ideal candidate possesses an "owner's mindset" and is relentlessly persistent - you do not let tasks slide, and you proactively follow up on every open item until it is 100% resolved.



Key Responsibilities



Rapid, High-Standard Responses: Manage the guest inbox across all platforms (Airbnb, Vrbo, Direct Booking), responding to inquiries within 5 minutes with a warm, professional, and on-brand tone.



Anticipatory Guest Support: Don't just answer questions - anticipate what the guest will need next. (e.g., If a guest asks about check-in, proactively provide parking details, local recommendations, and check-in steps before they have to ask).



Persistent Problem Resolution: Act as the first point of contact for guest issues (access codes, Wi-Fi, troubleshooting smart home tech). Own the problem from start to finish. If a local contact doesn't respond immediately, you don't wait—you follow up persistently until the guest's issue is fully resolved and confirmed.



Review Maximization & Management: Actively monitor guest sentiment mid-stay to resolve minor issues early. Respond to post-stay reviews and diligently build cases to dispute unfair reviews according to platform policies.



Flawless Turnover Scheduling: Coordinate and schedule cleaning crews daily. Double-check calendar synchronizations across all platforms to guarantee zero missed cleanings.



Quality Control Oversight: Review turnover photos and checklists submitted by cleaners with an eagle eye. Diligently flag and address any missed details (e.g., uneven bed tucks, low inventory, or missed dust) before the next guest arrives.



Relentless Maintenance Coordination: Proactively coordinate with local handymen and providers. Track ongoing maintenance tickets and persistently follow up with vendors until you have physical or photographic proof that the job is completed to our standards.



Aggressive Claims Management: Diligently document and track any guest damages. Gather photographic evidence, cleaner statements, and repair estimates. Follow up relentlessly on pending AirCover or insurance claims until reimbursement is fully approved and paid.



Listing Maintenance: Assist with administrative tasks such as updating calendars, managing listings, and refreshing local guidebooks to keep our digital presence competitive.



Qualifications & Requirements



Experience: 5+ years of direct experience in Airbnb/short-term rental property management and hospitality is strictly required.



Proactive & Persistent Follow-Through: You have a natural drive to close open loops. You do not let tasks sit on "pending" without active, continuous follow-up. You are comfortably persistent when dealing with unresponsive guests, cleaners, vendors, or support platforms.



Extreme Attention to Detail: You are someone who spots a typo from a mile away and notices when a cleaner's photo doesn’t match our standard property layout.



Superb Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English skills. You can write polished, empathetic, and grammatically perfect messages under pressure, while still maintaining a firm and professional stance when chasing down resolutions.



Software Proficiency: Highly comfortable navigating Property Management Systems (PMS) like Guesty or Hospitable, alongside turnover platforms (e.g., Breezeway) and dynamic pricing tools.



Workspace & Schedule: A reliable, high-speed internet connection with a backup power/internet solution, a quiet workspace, and the ability to work shifts aligned with US time zones.



Why Join Us?



Professional Growth: We value talent and reward proactive, high-performing team members who drive results with increased responsibility, growth opportunities, and performance-based bonuses.



Collaborative Environment: We provide documented SOPs and training, but we welcome your ideas on how to optimize and improve them.



Empowered Autonomy: We trust you to do your job. If you are diligent, persistent, and proactive, you will find a highly supportive, collaborative, and rewarding environment here.



How to Apply (Our First Attention-to-Detail & Follow-Through Test)



To prove you are the diligent and persistent professional we are looking for, please reply with:



A copy of your resume highlighting your experience managing short-term rentals.

The name of the Property Management Software (PMS) you are most comfortable using.

An example of a time you had to be highly persistent to resolve a difficult property management or guest issue.



Include the word "Detail-Oriented" in the 1st sentence of your response to us (Note: Applications that do not follow these two instructions precisely will be automatically disqualified).

title: Senior Brand Manager needed to support 10+ Amazon brands for growth, execution, drive performance and operation
description:
About Prodigy Media



Prodigy Media is an established e-commerce company with over a decade of experience developing, launching, and scaling private-label brands, primarily on Amazon USA.



We manage a diverse portfolio of brands across multiple categories and are looking for an experienced Senior Amazon Brand Manager to take ownership of brand performance, identify growth opportunities, and lead day-to-day execution.



We're looking for someone with extensive Amazon marketplace experience who understands how to grow brands, improve profitability, launch products successfully, and coordinate teams to get results.



This is a senior-level position for someone who can think strategically, solve problems independently, and take ownership of performance.



We're also embracing modern AI tools to help our team work smarter, faster, and more efficiently. Experience with Claude, Codex, or automation tools is highly valued, but strong Amazon brand management experience is our number one priority.



Key Responsibilities



1. Amazon Brand Management & Growth

You'll be responsible for overseeing and improving the performance of assigned Amazon private-label brands.

Manage multiple Amazon brands and product portfolios.

Analyze sales, profitability, organic rankings, conversion rates, traffic, and advertising performance.

Identify opportunities to increase revenue, improve margins, and grow market share.

Develop and execute strategies to improve underperforming products.

Oversee listing optimization, SEO, A+ Content, Brand Stores, and conversion improvements.

Conduct competitive analysis and identify market opportunities.

Monitor inventory-related issues that affect sales and performance.

Develop clear short-term and long-term growth strategies for assigned brands.

Our expectation: You don't just maintain Amazon listings. You actively manage and grow the business.



2. Data Analysis, Problem Solving & Execution



Strong analytical skills are essential, but identifying problems is only the beginning.

We're looking for someone who can:

Analyze data to identify declining sales, poor conversion rates, advertising inefficiencies, and other performance issues.

Investigate the underlying causes rather than simply reporting numbers.

Develop practical solutions supported by research and data.

Implement corrective actions and coordinate the necessary resources.

Monitor results and continuously improve strategies.

Take responsibility for resolving issues from beginning to end.

We don't need someone who simply tells us what's wrong. We need someone who knows how to fix it and takes action.



3. Amazon Product Launches



You must have direct, hands-on experience launching private-label products on Amazon.

Responsibilities include:

Conducting product and competitor research.

Performing keyword research and analyzing market opportunities.

Developing product launch strategies, budgets, and timelines.

Coordinating product photography, listing content, A+ Content, and launch assets.

Working with PPC specialists on launch campaigns and advertising strategies.

Planning compliant product review acquisition strategies.

Coordinating inventory readiness and launch schedules.

Monitoring launch performance and optimizing strategies to improve rankings, conversions, and sales.

You should understand the complete Amazon launch process, from preparation to successful market entry and continued growth.



4. Team Coordination & Project Management



You'll work directly with our PPC specialists, graphic designers, and operations team to ensure brand initiatives are completed effectively.

Coordinate PPC strategies and campaign priorities with advertising specialists.

Work closely with graphic designers to develop listing images, A+ Content, advertising creatives, and product videos.

Assign projects, set clear priorities, and establish realistic due dates.

Manage multiple ongoing projects and ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.

Review creative assets and campaign initiatives to ensure they support brand objectives.

Identify bottlenecks and resolve delays before they affect performance.

Maintain accountability and clear communication across teams.

Use project management systems to organize assignments, responsibilities, and deadlines.

You must be comfortable leading execution, making decisions, and ensuring that important work gets completed without constant supervision.



5. External Marketing & Brand Development



While Amazon is our main sales channel, we also want to expand our brand presence and customer acquisition efforts beyond Amazon.

Experience or familiarity with the following is valuable:

 and Instagram advertising.

TikTok marketing and short-form video content.

Influencer marketing and UGC creators.

External traffic strategies that drive customers to Amazon.

Affiliate marketing and customer acquisition campaigns.

Shopify and direct-to-consumer marketing.

We're looking for someone who understands how to use outside marketing channels to build brand awareness and support Amazon sales growth.



6. AI Tools, Automation & Operational Improvements



We're continuously improving our business through AI and modern technology.

While this is not a software development position, we value Amazon professionals who are comfortable using AI to improve their productivity and solve business problems.

Experience with the following is a strong advantage:

Claude and Claude Code.

OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT.

AI-assisted Amazon research, analytics, and reporting.

Automating repetitive business tasks and workflows.

Building or customizing simple internal tools using AI.

We especially value people who are willing to invest time in exploring AI-powered applications or automations that eliminate operational bottlenecks and help the company operate more efficiently.



Minimum Qualifications



Required:

At least 4 years of proven Amazon brand management experience, preferably managing US private-label brands.

Demonstrated experience growing Amazon sales and improving brand performance.

Direct experience successfully launching new products on Amazon.

Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Amazon SEO, listing optimization, and advertising fundamentals.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn insights into practical solutions.

Experience coordinating with PPC specialists, graphic designers, and other team members.

Excellent project management skills, including assigning priorities and meeting deadlines.

Good understanding of Amazon profitability, margins, conversion rates, and organic rankings.

Familiarity with external marketing strategies.

Strong English communication and independent problem-solving skills.



Highly Preferred:



Experience managing multiple Amazon brands simultaneously.

Advanced knowledge of Data Dive, Helium 10, and Amazon Brand Analytics.

Experience with Meta, TikTok, influencer marketing, or UGC campaigns.

Practical experience using Claude, Codex, and other AI tools.

Experience creating automations, dashboards, or simple internal business applications.

Familiarity with ClickUp, Notion, and workflow management systems.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a proactive, results-driven Amazon professional who:

Understands what drives profitable Amazon brand growth.

Can manage multiple brands and identify the right priorities.

Takes ownership of problems and follows through until they're resolved.

Works effectively with PPC specialists and graphic designers.

Can independently coordinate projects, deadlines, and resources.

Is constantly looking for opportunities to improve business performance.

Is open to adopting AI tools and developing more efficient systems.



As an experienced Amazon Brand Manager first, with a strong interest in using technology to become even more effective.



What Success Looks Like

During your first 90 days, we expect you to:

Develop a clear understanding of your assigned brands and their performance.

Identify the biggest opportunities to improve sales, profitability, and conversion rates.

Create actionable growth plans with measurable objectives.

Resolve high-priority issues affecting brand performance.

Establish effective coordination with PPC specialists and graphic designers.

Improve project accountability and timely delivery of creative and marketing initiatives.

Demonstrate strong ownership, independent decision-making, and measurable progress.

Identify opportunities where AI tools or automation could make existing workflows more efficient.



Most importantly, you take ownership of the results.



If this sounds like you and you would like to apply. Please send your resume directly to myself with the subject line : SBM with Passion for AI





Tam Ma

Co Founder - Prodigy Media

title: QA & CRM Setup Specialist
description:
Detail-Obsessed QA & CRM Setup Specialist | Full-Time | Training Provided



Salary: $650 USD/month starting

Employment: Full-Time, 40 hours/week

Location: Remote — Philippines

Schedule: Monday–Friday, with 4 required overlapping hours

Experience: No GoHighLevel experience required



Most people would find this job boring. A few will find it perfect.



If you love checklists, catching small mistakes, following exact instructions, and making sure everything works correctly, this could be the perfect job for you.



Please read this entire posting before applying. Your ability to follow the application instructions is part of our hiring process.



About Blue Rhino AI



Blue Rhino AI is a US-based company that helps chiropractic clinics attract and schedule new patients using advertising, booking systems, CRM automation, and AI chat assistants.



Our AI handles much of the planning. We need someone who can carefully execute written instructions, test systems, identify errors, and document completed work.



We value accuracy over speed and attention to detail over experience.



What You’ll Do



1. CRM Account Setup



* Set up client accounts in GoHighLevel using step-by-step instructions.

* Enter exact names, prices, appointment times, links, and settings.

* Double-check every field before marking a task complete.

* Stop and ask questions whenever instructions don’t match what appears on your screen.



2. Quality Assurance (QA) Testing



* Submit test forms and verify the results.

* Book test appointments and confirm they appear correctly.

* Check links, booking pages, and automated workflows.

* Identify errors and provide screenshots showing exactly what happened.



3. Daily Task Execution



* Follow a daily task list generated by our AI system.

* Complete assigned tasks using documented procedures.

* Prepare tasks requiring management approval.

* Flag missing information, conflicting instructions, or incorrect numbers.



4. Documentation



* Maintain accurate records of completed work.

* Record what was done and when.

* Attach screenshots as proof.

* Clearly communicate anything that needs attention.



What This Job Is NOT



You will NOT be responsible for:



* Creating marketing strategies.

* Managing
 advertising campaigns.

* Writing marketing content.

* Editing videos.

* Selling services or talking to patients.

* Making decisions without instructions.



This is a precision-focused execution and quality assurance position.



Our Three Non-Negotiable Rules



Rule #1: Never Guess



If something is unclear, stop and ask. Even a correct guess is unacceptable.



Rule #2: Follow Instructions Exactly



If your screen doesn’t match the instructions, report exactly what you see. Do not improvise.



Rule #3: Prove Your Work



A task is not complete until it has been performed, checked, and documented with screenshots.



Who We’re Looking For



You may be a great fit if you:



* Enjoy repetitive, structured work.

* Notice small details other people overlook.

* Follow written instructions carefully.

* Are comfortable asking questions.

* Take responsibility for mistakes.

* Have strong written English.

* Are organized, dependable, and patient.

* Prefer accuracy over rushing.



Helpful backgrounds include QA testing, bookkeeping, data entry, medical documentation, legal administration, pharmacy, nursing, or quality control.



No 
 or
 Ads experience is required. We will train you using our own procedures.



Work Schedule and Compensation



* Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday.

* Required overlap: 8:00 AM–12:00 PM Mexico City time (10:00 PM–2:00 AM Philippine time during Mexico City’s standard time).

* Remaining 4 hours per day are flexible.

* Starting salary: $650 USD/month.

* Performance-based raises tied to measurable accuracy and reliability.

* Paid training and onboarding.

* Long-term opportunity for the right person.



Technical Requirements



* Your own computer with at least 8 GB RAM.

* Reliable internet connection of at least 25 Mbps.

* Backup internet or power solution.

* Ability to capture and share screenshots.

* A quiet, dependable workspace.



Our Hiring Process



1. Written application.

2. Paid 90-minute skills test ($15 USD, whether or not you are hired).

3. Short video interview.

4. Paid 30-day probation with a written performance scorecard.



You will also sign a confidentiality agreement because this role involves access to private business and potentially patient information.



How to Apply — Follow Every Instruction



Applications that miss any step will not be reviewed.



This is intentional. Following exact instructions is the most important part of the job.



Step 1 —
 Subject Line



Use this exact format:



QA-7 | [Your First Name] | [Earliest Daily Start Time in Mexico City Time]



Example:



QA-7 | Maria | 8:00 AM



Step 2 — Answer These Three Questions



Answer in order. Each answer must be fewer than 80 words.



A. Tell us about a time written instructions didn’t match what appeared on your screen. What exactly did you do?



B. Describe a mistake you made at work that mattered. How do you check your work now?



C. What annoys you most about instructions written by other people?



Step 3 — Complete a Free DISC Personality Test



Take the assessment here:







Include your four DISC scores (D, I, S, C) as numbers. Do not submit only a personality type or description.



Step 4 — Internet Speed Test



Visit:



https://www.speedtest.net/



Run a speed test on the day you apply and include a link to your result.



Step 5 — Do Not Attach a Resume



We are evaluating your attention to detail, written responses, and ability to follow directions, not how impressive your resume looks.



We are looking for one dependable, highly accurate person who wants a stable, long-term position with Blue Rhino AI.

Your role will be to analyse these behaviours and create intelligent automated workflows around them.



Examples:



1. New customer registers but doesn't open the welcome email → what happens next?

2. Customer opens emails but doesn't log in → how do we engage them?

3. Customer views 5+ properties but doesn't enquire → should we follow up?

4. Customer repeatedly views HMOs → should their communication change?

5. Customer hasn't logged in for 30/60/90 days → how do we reactivate them?

6. Customer clicks a property from a marketing email → what happens next?

7. Highly engaged customer → when should our team personally contact them?



You will help us build:



Registration → Onboarding → Engagement → Enquiry → Conversion → Retention → Reactivation



Your Responsibilities



You will:



1. Map and improve existing customer journeys

2. Build automated CRM/email workflows

3. Create behaviour-based triggers and follow-ups

4. Segment customers based on activity and interests

5. Improve onboarding and reactivation

6. Plan email sequences and follow-ups

7. Analyse opens, clicks, property views, enquiries and conversions

8. A/B test workflows and messaging

9. Identify gaps where customers are not being followed up

10. Recommend new workflows based on customer data



We want someone who proactively finds opportunities, rather than waiting to be told what workflow to build.



Experience We're Looking For



You should have real hands-on experience with CRM, lifecycle or marketing automation.



Experience with platforms such as:



ActiveCampaign / HubSpot / 
 / GoHighLevel / Klaviyo / Make / Zapier or similar is useful, but your ability to design good workflows is more important than knowing a particular platform.



Ideally, you have 2+ years' experience in CRM automation, lifecycle marketing, marketing operations, SaaS/customer engagement or similar.



Please Don't Apply If...



Your experience is mainly:



- General VA work

- Sending newsletters

- Basic Mailchimp campaigns

- Simple Zapier automations

- Courses without real commercial experience



We are specifically looking for someone who has personally built and improved customer automation workflows.



How to Apply



Start your application with:



PIA WORKFLOW 26



Then answer ONLY these 3 questions:



1. Show us something you've built.

Describe ONE real customer workflow you personally created.

What triggered it? What happened next? What software did you use? What result did it achieve?

Where possible, include an anonymised screenshot, workflow diagram or Loom video showing your work.



2. Solve this problem.

A new PIA customer opens our welcome email and then views 9 investment properties over 7 days but makes no enquiry.

What would you make happen next?

Keep your answer short. We want to understand how you think, not receive a long essay.



3. What tools have you actually used?

List the CRM/automation platforms you have personally worked with and rate yourself:

Beginner / Intermediate / Advanced

Also tell us your expected monthly salary in PHP.



Important



Please don't send us a generic cover letter.



We don't care about perfectly written applications. We care about evidence, experience and how you think.



Shortlisted candidates will have a video interview and may be given a small paid practical workflow exercise before we make our final decision.



We are looking for someone who can ultimately own the customer journey and workflow strategy within Property Investor App.



If that's you, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Bookkeeper - Sage 50 (UK) + AI-Assisted Bookkeeping
description:
We're a UK property group (8 limited companies: HMOs, serviced accommodation and two property-tech apps) looking for a part-time bookkeeper who knows Sage 50 Accounts (UK desktop) well and is genuinely comfortable working with AI.



HOW THE JOB WORKS

This is an oversight and quality-control role, not data entry. Our AI system already does the bulk of the work: every morning it codes each bank transaction for every company (BR/BP, nominal code, department, VAT code), prepares the Sage import files and flags anything it's unsure of. Your job is to make sure everything the AI produces is correct before it goes into Sage: check its work, fix mistakes, resolve the flagged items, import the approved entries into Sage 50, and confirm every bank account reconciles to the penny.



YOU WILL

- Review the daily AI posting report and approve, correct or query each entry

- Import approved entries into Sage 50 (audit trail CSV import)

- Check that all 8 Tide bank accounts and the company credit card reconcile each month

- Make sure inter-company loans, director's loan entries and mortgage capital/interest splits are posted correctly

- Keep nominal codes and property departments tidy across all 8 Sage companies

- Spot patterns in the AI's mistakes and turn them into clear rules so they don't happen again

- Take Sage backups and prepare files for our UK accountant at year end



YOU MUST HAVE

- 2+ years hands-on with Sage 50 Accounts UK: bank receipts/payments, journals, departments, imports, bank reconciliation

- UK bookkeeping knowledge: double entry, VAT, inter-company and director's loan accounts

- Daily use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) in your work, and a sharp eye for when AI gets things wrong

- Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills

- Excellent English and attention to detail



NICE TO HAVE

UK property clients (HMOs, 
 payouts), multi-company bookkeeping, Tide, Stripe.



HOURS AND PAY

Part time and flexible, around 10 hours per week to start (roughly 30 minutes a day reviewing, plus month-end checks). Hourly rate to be discussed with candidates according to skill set and experience.



TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "SAGE 50 READY", then include:

- Your full name,
 address and phone number (WhatsApp if you have it)

- Answers to these 3 questions:

1. Which version of Sage 50 have you used, and for how many UK companies?

2. In Sage 50, how would you record £2,000 that Company A lends to Company B, in both companies' books?

3. Describe one specific way you use AI in bookkeeping today, and how you check its output is correct.



Applications without the phrase, contact details or the answers won't be reviewed. We keep the details of strong applicants on file and may contact you about future openings.

title: Speech & Debate Teaching Assistant
description:
Good Feedback Builds Better Speakers.

Position Summary

Elorae supports education programs in Korea, including Leaders Academy, where students develop their public speaking, debate, writing, and critical thinking. We are looking for a Speech & Debate Teaching Assistant to help our coaches assess student work and produce strong curriculum.

You will help identify what a student is doing well, what needs to improve, and what materials will help them get there. Strong performance can lead to coaching responsibilities over time.

Experienced applicants may join as a VA. Applicants with limited professional experience may join as paid interns. Competitive, club, school, and university experience can count: show us what you have actually done.

What This Role Involves

Review student speeches, debate performances, recordings, and written work using our assessment criteria and coach guidance.

Prepare clear, specific feedback on argument, organization, evidence, language, delivery, and engagement with other speakers.

Record assessment results, organize feedback, and help track student progress.

Research topics and develop lesson plans, exercises, model examples, debate briefs, assessment materials, and teacher guides.

Adapt materials to different ages, English levels, and stages of competition preparation.

Revise curriculum and feedback in response to coach review; check facts, sources, and event requirements.

Support practice activities and, as your ability develops, take on supervised teaching and coaching.

Who This Is For

Experience with public speaking, competitive debate, or Model United Nations (MUN) events is preferred. Competitors, judges, coaches, club officers, organizers, and people who have supported these events are all welcome to apply.

Teaching, tutoring, curriculum writing, assessment, English, education, or communications experience is useful. Excellent spoken and written English, sound judgment, and the ability to explain an improvement clearly matter more than a long list of titles.

You should be comfortable receiving direct feedback and revising your work. An inexperienced applicant with relevant event experience, strong English, and good judgment may be a better fit than an experienced general VA with no interest in the subject.

A Path to Coaching

This role starts with assessments and curriculum support. Applicants who demonstrate subject knowledge, reliable assessment judgment, and the ability to work effectively with students may progress into coaching. Advancement depends on performance and program needs.

A Word About Your Setup

You need your own laptop or desktop, a functioning webcam and microphone, stable internet of at least 30 Mbps download with acceptable latency, and a quiet workspace suitable for focused work and video calls. Google Docs, Sheets, and Drive should be familiar territory. Some overlap with Korea Standard Time is required; tell us your availability for live sessions, including evenings or weekends.

Hours and Payment

Part-time, with the initial hours agreed according to your availability and the work assigned. Hours and responsibilities may expand based on performance and program needs.

Experienced VA: paid probation begins at 5,000 KRW per hour.

Paid intern: 100 PHP per hour from day one. Applicants with limited professional experience are welcome; relevant school, university, club, or competition work can support your application.

Application Process

Experienced applicants — complete the VA application:



Applicants with limited experience — complete the Intern application:



Choose Curriculum and select the closest available Speech, Debate, or Curriculum Assistant options. In your OnlineJobs.ph message, identify this role as “Speech & Debate Teaching Assistant.”

Include your CV and any relevant speech, debate, MUN, teaching, writing, curriculum, or assessment samples. Student work is welcome if it is yours. Tell us which events you have participated in, your role, and your weekly availability. If you have given feedback to another speaker, include a short example.

Attentiveness Test

Write “Voice” in your OnlineJobs.ph subject line so we know you read the full posting.

One Last Thing

“Good job, be more confident” is not a useful assessment. We need someone who can identify a specific problem and explain a practical next step. If you use AI, you remain responsible for the accuracy, quality, and teaching value of the result.

title: Wellness Coach
description:
Help People Build Habits That Last.

Position Summary

We are looking for a remote Wellness Coach to provide consistent exercise instruction and practical support with everyday health habits. Your work combines live instruction, thoughtful preparation, and clear follow-up using information about the client’s exercise, nutrition, sleep, and progress.

Each client is allocated five paid hours per week. Experienced applicants may join as a VA; applicants with limited professional experience may join as paid interns if they have a relevant foundation and can demonstrate the skills needed for the work.

How the Five Hours Work

3 hours — Exercise instruction: three live, one-hour sessions each week. Lead the client on camera, demonstrate exercises, observe technique, explain adjustments, and maintain a suitable pace.

1 hour — Preparation: plan the sessions, review previous results, select exercises and alternatives, and adjust the coming week’s program to the client’s goals, ability, and available equipment.

1 hour — Communication and data: check in with the client, gather and organize information such as nutrition records, sleep patterns, activity, and adherence, and summarize progress and next steps.

All five hours are paid, including preparation and communication/data work. The allocation is per client: two clients would represent ten hours per week. Client assignments and the live-session schedule are agreed in advance.

What This Role Involves

Lead reliable, engaging exercise sessions and explain movements in clear English.

Build a practical routine around the client’s goals, current ability, schedule, and equipment.

Track attendance, exercise progress, and agreed habit measures in simple, organized records.

Help the client stay consistent with exercise, nutrition habits, sleep routines, and agreed commitments.

Use the information collected to make sensible adjustments and flag questions that need follow-up.

Keep client information confidential and work within your training and qualifications.

Who This Is For

Personal training, fitness instruction, sports coaching, physical education, exercise science, or related experience is valuable. Relevant study, certifications, and experience leading others strengthen your application. Tell us what you are qualified to teach and show us how you teach it.

You need clear spoken English, confidence leading on camera, and the ability to demonstrate exercises and give understandable feedback. Warmth, consistency, preparation, and professional judgment matter. You should be comfortable discussing habits and progress without shaming or lecturing the client.

For an internship, extensive paid coaching experience is not required. A relevant educational or practical foundation, willingness to learn, and demonstrated ability to lead appropriate exercise are still important.

A Word About Your Setup

Sessions are remote and live on camera. You need a private, quiet space with enough room to demonstrate movements, a camera angle that shows those movements clearly, a functioning microphone, and reliable access to video calls and shared records.

You need your own laptop or desktop and stable internet of at least 30 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload with acceptable latency. Clients may be based in Korea, so availability at agreed Korea Standard Time session times is required. Tell us your available days and times.

Hours and Payment

Five paid hours per client per week, divided as set out above. Additional clients may be assigned based on performance, availability, and demand.

Experienced VA: paid probation begins at 5,000 KRW per hour.

Paid intern: 100 PHP per hour from day one. Experience and demonstrated readiness determine the appropriate track.

Application Process

Experienced applicants — complete the VA application:



Applicants with limited experience — complete the Intern application:



Choose Specialists and identify the role as “Wellness Coach.” Include your CV, relevant qualifications or certifications, and any coaching or exercise-instruction samples you already have.

In your OnlineJobs.ph message, tell us about your relevant experience, the types of clients or goals you can support, your available live-session times, and how you would organize the five-hour weekly allocation. If you have no professional coaching experience, explain the relevant study or practical experience you would bring as an intern.

Attentiveness Test

Write “Workout” in your OnlineJobs.ph subject line so we know you read the full posting.

One Last Thing

You will lead real sessions, prepare for them, and follow through on what the client reports. We need someone who can make steady progress feel practical and achievable.

title: Divorce & Family Law Paralegal

Required Qualifications:

* Prior experience working directly for a divorce or family law attorney — required.

* Demonstrated experience drafting divorce-related legal documents — required.

* Strong familiarity with divorce proceedings, family law terminology, and legal documentation.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong legal writing, proofreading, and document preparation skills.

* Excellent organization, time management, and attention to detail.

* Ability to independently manage assignments and follow through on deadlines.

* Strong client communication skills, professionalism, and emotional intelligence.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, PDF tools, and legal case management software.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience with contested and uncontested divorces.

* Familiarity with child custody/time-sharing, child support, alimony, and equitable distribution matters.

* Experience in Trusts & Estates, including estate planning, wills, trusts, or probate administration — a plus, not required.

* Experience with legal practice management platforms such as Clio, MyCase, or similar systems.





Ideal Candidate:

We are looking for someone who is:

* Experienced: Already understands divorce law workflows and legal documentation.

* Independent: Can draft documents and manage assignments without constant supervision.

* Detail-Oriented: Produces accurate, organized, and professional legal work.

What Success Looks Like:

The successful VA will become a dependable extension of the team.

They will be able to prepare divorce-related legal documents for attorney review, manage case details, communicate effectively with clients, and keep legal matters moving forward with minimal oversight.



The priority is finding an experienced divorce paralegal who can contribute immediately, produce quality legal work, and meaningfully reduce the attorney's administrative and case-management workload.

Experience with Trusts & Estates would provide additional value and versatility to the firm, but divorce and family law experience remains the primary hiring requirement.
