title: Video Ad Editor (AI - First)
description:
⚠️ HOW TO APPLY: Applications without a Loom video link are deleted unread. Start your message with the words "AI-FIRST EDITOR" so we know you read the whole post.



WHO WE ARE

We are a fast-growing, seven-figure health and wellness ecommerce brand. We help people in pain feel human again, and we grow through Meta ads in the US. You'll get clear, detailed briefs and scripts every day, so you can focus on what you do best: turning them into ads people stop scrolling for.



Once you've proven your ambition, you'll get extensive on-the-job training. Learn how ads that sell are made, and you can grow from a video editor into the person who plans our ads, earning a multi-five-figure USD salary.



You'd be a full-time creative hire, working directly with the founder. You'll have clear weekly targets, a weekly meeting where we review how last week's ads performed and what to make next, and a weekly presentation from you: what you learned, where you learned it, and how you'll apply it to your edits.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

You won't spend your days dragging clips on a timeline. We edit with AI: AI drives editing software, and we use AI tools for voice and music. B-roll depends on the ad: AI-generated for animated or claymation ads etc., and for other ads our own footage library, stock footage or clips you source online. Your job is to guide the AI, pick the right footage for each scene, and make great ads fast. Quality + Speed. When your ads perform well, you earn a bonus.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Turn raw footage and AI b-roll into scroll-stopping ads, fast

- Direct AI tools to cut, caption, resize and create variations

- Make different versions of the first 3 seconds of an ad every week, and learn which ones people stop for



REQUIREMENTS

- AI-first editor: you already use AI to automate your editing (cutting, captions, b-roll, voiceover, resizes), and your job is to direct it and check the output, not to drag clips by hand

- Resourceful: when you hit a problem, you find the tool, the tutorial or the workaround yourself before asking

- You build systems: if you do something twice, you look for a way to automate it

- You've edited ads (not just YouTube or wedding videos) and can explain why an ad's first 3 seconds grab attention

- Hungry: you're learning something new every week, and you never settle once you're comfortable

- Reliable: you hit deadlines and communicate without being chased

- Strong written English: you can follow a detailed brief exactly



DEAL-BREAKERS

- You've never used AI in your editing

- You need step-by-step instructions to figure out new tools

- You miss deadlines without telling anyone

- You want part-time work or are juggling other clients. This is a full-time role.

- You edit everything by hand and aren't interested in automating it

- You stop learning once the job feels comfortable



PAY

$1,800+/month base, set by your paid test. Plus a cash bonus for every ad you edit that becomes one of our best performers: up to $250 per ad, no limit on how many. Raise review at 90 days. No ceiling: if your ads earn it, you earn it.



HIRING PROCESS

1. Loom application (below)

2. 20-minute call

3. Paid test project: one short ad from our brief, delivered within 48 hours

4. Offer + 30-day trial



HOW TO APPLY (required — applications without a Loom are not reviewed)

Record a Loom, max 5 minutes:

1. Introduce yourself in 30 seconds

2. Show 2–3 ads you're proud of, and their results if you have them

3. Show your screen and walk us through the hardest editing problem you've solved using AI or a workaround you built. What was the problem, and how exactly did you solve it? Any tools are fine.



PS: A year from now, you'll either still be taking small gigs, or you'll be earning more than you thought possible while learning how winning ads are made and the fundamentals of marketing. 

The difference is what you do in the next 5 minutes. Record the Loom today.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
Working with an ambitious business development manager with one of Australia’s best business   telecommunications providers, we’re looking for a confident B2B Appointment Setter to help us connect with business owners and decision-makers across Australia.



Your job is simple: Make calls to enriched lists, and book qualified meetings to fill calendar.



You’ll work from enriched, researched and targeted prospect lists containing business names, contact numbers, and key information about the industry, business and the area in which they operate.



You will not be baby sat, you’ll be provided a dialler, CRM access to update notes, and support as required. If it takes you 1 hour to book out the following week so be it you’ll be paid the same!



You won’t need to prepare quotes, negotiate contracts, or close sales. As a matter of fact we DON’T want that at all. The bdm will handle that at the meeting. Your job is to:

1. Be tactical and use provided information to build enough curiosity to get them keen to see us.

2. After they agree to meet, run a quick qualification to confirm the #of handsets, their current provider, their current monthly spend and wether they’re in a contract or not.



Role is open to ANY AND ALL APPLICANTS who think themselves capable, What You’ll Be Doing:



* Make outbound calls to Australian businesses

* Speak with business owners, practice managers, office managers, and other decision-makers building curiosity to book meetings

* Introduce the problems we specialise in and how we’ve helped other businesses similar to theirs

* Identify businesses interested in reviewing or upgrading their existing services.

* Book qualified appointments directly into a shared calendar so you’re not clashing with other booked meetings

* Maintain accurate CRM records and appointment notes critical to ensure bdm is well equipped before attending the meeting

* Follow up with interested prospects when necessary, more likely to book and have our team close on the follow-up 



Our target is 8 qualified meetings per week.



Compensation – Performance Based, NOT time based. If it takes you 1 hour to get 6 qualified meetings minimum and you don’t want to work more that’s fine. If you book all 10 qualified meetings then you’ll be paid adjusted.



You earn:



* AUD $25 for every qualified appointment successfully booked and attended.

* Additional AUD $50 when your appointment results in a successfully closed sale.



That’s AUD $75 total for every qualified appointment that becomes a paying customer.



Example Weekly Earnings



Weekly Results: 4 qualified meetings attended

Total Earnings: AUD $100



8 qualified meetings attended

Total Earnings: AUD $200



8 meetings + 2 closed sales

Total Earnings: AUD $300 + Bonus $5 Per Closed Meeting Stacked = $310



8 meetings + 4 closed sales

Total Earnings: AUD $400 + Bonus $5 Per Closed Meeting Stacked = $420



10 meetings + 5 closed sales

Total Earnings: AUD $500 + Bonus $5 Per Closed Meeting Stacked = $525
salary: $25 Per Meeting, $50 Per Closed With Bon

title: DTC AI Video Editor
description:
The Role



We're looking for a DTC AI Video Editor with proven experience working with 7-, 8- or 9-figure e-commerce brands.



You need to understand direct response, not just editing.



Our creative strategists will provide the script, angle and brief — roughly 50% of the ad. Your job is to own the other 50%:



- Choose the strongest footage from our B-roll library.

- Identify where the concept needs stronger or more specific visuals.

- Generate new AI content when existing footage isn't good enough.

- Make every visual congruent with the script, hook and emotional beat.

- Edit for attention, clarity, retention and conversion.

- Proactively improve the visual concept rather than simply executing instructions.



The goal isn't to make videos that look good. The goal is to make ads that perform.



What You'll Own



You'll be responsible for producing a minimum of 12–15 finished concepts per week, with some concepts requiring original AI content generation.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Editing short-form DTC direct-response ads across multiple formats.

- Translating scripts and briefs into strong visual narratives.

- Selecting B-roll based on the psychology and intent of each line.

- Generating missing visuals using AI rather than settling for weak footage.

- Creating high-quality AI UGC, animation and other AI-native creative formats.

- Using tools/models such as Higgsfield, Seedance and Kling to a professional standard.

- Building strong hooks, pattern interrupts, pacing and visual escalation.

- Maintaining script-to-visual congruence throughout every creative.

- Finding ways to increase viewer retention without distracting from the sales message.

- Bringing new visual ideas to the creative strategists.

- Learning from winning and losing ads and improving future execution accordingly.

- Taking ownership of the finished creative rather than waiting to be told exactly what to do.



Who We're Looking For



Non-negotiables



- Proven video-editing experience with successful DTC/e-commerce brands, ideally at 7-, 8- or 9-figure scale.

- Strong knowledge of direct-response advertising fundamentals.

- A portfolio demonstrating performance-focused paid social creative — not only polished brand content.

- High-level AI content generation ability.

- Hands-on experience with modern AI video workflows, ideally including Higgsfield, Seedance and Kling.

- Ability to create convincing AI UGC, animation and other visual formats.

- Strong instinct for matching visuals to copy.

- Understanding of hooks, pacing, pattern interrupts, curiosity, emotion, proof and retention.

- Ability to work at volume without allowing quality to collapse.

- Comfortable receiving a brief and independently solving visual problems.



The mindset



We're looking for someone who is:



- Obsessed with getting better.

- Extremely motivated.

- Proactive rather than reactive.

- Comfortable taking ownership.

- Curious about why an ad works, not merely how it was edited.

- Hungry to become an elite direct-response marketer, not just an editor.

- Excited by a fast-moving environment where standards continue to rise.



If you need every visual decision mapped out for you before you can start editing, this isn't the right role.



What Great Looks Like



A great editor on our team doesn't read a line in a script and ask:



> "What clip should I put here?"

> 



They ask:



> "What does the viewer need to see here for this line to hit as hard as possible?"

> 



If the right clip exists in the B-roll folder, use it.



If it doesn't, create it.



If the brief can be made stronger visually, say so and improve it.



You should be thinking about:



- What stops the scroll?

- Does the first visual strengthen the hook?

- Is every shot supporting what the voiceover is saying?

- Where could attention drop?

- Can this claim be demonstrated instead of stated?

- Is there a stronger visual proof?

- Does the edit build desire, belief or curiosity with every beat?

- What could we generate that would make this concept substantially stronger?



AI Capability



AI generation is a core part of this role — not an optional extra.



You should be comfortable generating production-ready creative across formats such as:



- AI UGC

- Character-led scenes

- Product-integrated scenes

- Cinematic B-roll

- Animations

- Visual metaphors

- Scroll-stopping hook visuals

- Scenes that would be difficult or expensive to shoot traditionally



We want to see real examples of your AI work and understand which tools/models you used to produce them.



Output & Working Rhythm



- Minimum 12–15 concepts per week.

- Mix of traditional editing and AI-assisted/generated concepts.

- Fast iteration based on creative feedback and performance learnings.

- Consistent communication with our creative strategists.

- High standards for both speed and execution.



We care about output, but volume without quality is not the goal. We want someone capable of building a repeatable workflow that delivers both.



Growth Opportunity



This is intended to be a long-term position.



For the right person, there is a clear opportunity to grow into:



- Lead Video Editor, taking ownership of editing standards and potentially helping develop other editors.

- Creative Strategist, if you develop strong enough direct-response, research and concepting ability.



We'll actively coach and train you in direct response while you work with us. We want someone who wants to compound their skill set and become a significantly stronger marketer over time.



Team Environment



You'll be joining a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand with a highly driven team.



We're ambitious about where we're taking the brand, and creative is one of the most important growth levers in the business.



That means this role comes with real ownership and real expectations.



Only apply if you're genuinely excited by a fast-moving, high-performance environment and want to take responsibility for an area that directly impacts the growth of the company.



Application Process



Start your application with the word “STRATEGIST”



If your application doesn't begin with that word, we'll assume you haven't read the full brief.



Then include:



- A short introduction and the DTC brands you've worked with.

- Links to your 3–5 strongest direct-response ads.

- Links to your best AI-generated video work.

- The AI tools/models you currently use and what you use each for.

- A brief explanation of your goals/vision for role development over the next 1-2 years.

title: Operations & Administration VA | Electrical Trades, SOP Building
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with strong, verifiable operations or EA experience, ideally from a trades or construction business, and demonstrable SOP-building skills will be prioritised for this role.



An electrical business needs a self-directed, operations-first VA to take ownership of business administration, job management and SOP documentation. The role is operations and administration-led, not marketing-led — social media and website work remain part of the role, but at a scheduling and execution level, with content strategy handled by an external specialist. This is a strong, self-directed operator role: both directors want someone who takes a task, owns it completely, and delivers without needing to be followed up — someone who pushes back, asks good questions, and suggests a better way when they see one.



The role starts at 20 hours per week (4 hours per day, Monday to Friday), with the expectation this grows to full-time reasonably quickly as more tasks are handed over. A broader goal is a fully documented, less founder-dependent business that could run — or be sold — without day-to-day founder involvement by the end of 2027.



What You’ll Own



Operations, Administration & SOP-Building (Primary Focus)



General business administration support: assisting with quotes, invoicing for jobs, and timesheet administration in preparation for payroll

Contribute to building a fully documented, less founder-dependent business

Build out SOPs directly in Asana as processes are established, breaking each task down with the responsible person, day, and expected duration



Job Management (Katipolt)



Manage the back end of the job management platform: job cards, materials uploads, scheduling support, and related workflow

Draft invoices on job completion for maintenance and smaller jobs

Support quoting in the platform

Assist with materials coordination, including checking supplier deliveries and confirming gear is ready for upcoming jobs



Process Documentation



Document new workflows and processes as they’re refined and established — building the SOP library directly off live processes

Store and link all SOPs in Asana, accessible via the mobile app so field-based staff can reference them

Set a quarterly SOP review cadence to keep documentation accurate as the business evolves



 & Customer Communication



Monitor the inbox for customer replies to the business’s automated follow-up sequence, respond where appropriate, and close the loop in the system

Support customer communication throughout the job lifecycle, from initial enquiry through to job completion and follow-up

Manage customer comms within the job platform where possible



Social Media & Website (Scheduling-Level, Not Strategist-Level)



Receive approved content and manage scheduling and light repurposing (e.g. turning a video into a carousel or still-image post) across Instagram,
 and 
 using Meta Business Suite

title: On-Site Davao-based IT Specialist
description:
# Business Systems & AI Automation Engineer (Cursor / GitHub / E-commerce)



**Company:** SuperFulfill  

**Location:** On-Site Davao City

**Industry:** E-commerce, Logistics, 3PL, Software Automation



## About SuperFulfill



SuperFulfill is a China-based 3PL and fulfillment company serving international e-commerce brands. We handle product sourcing, warehousing, order fulfillment, inventory management, and worldwide shipping.



We're looking for a **tech-savvy, AI-driven developer** who can build automations, integrate existing systems, and improve our internal software using modern AI development tools.



Our development workflow relies heavily on **Cursor, AI-assisted coding, and GitHub**.



We value people who can turn business problems into working solutions quickly, without sacrificing reliability, accuracy, or maintainability.



This is not a traditional IT support role.



## Key Responsibilities



**1. AI-Assisted Software Development**

- Use Cursor and AI coding assistants to develop, modify, and maintain software.

- Build internal tools, scripts, dashboards, and automations.

- Work with existing repositories and understand unfamiliar codebases.

- Debug, test, and improve AI-generated code.

- Use GitHub for version control, branches, commits, pull requests, and code reviews.



**2. Business Process Automation**

- Identify manual and repetitive workflows across departments.

- Automate order processing, shipment tracking, invoicing, and reporting.

- Build automations connecting Google Sheets, APIs, ERP systems, and internal platforms.

- Reduce operational errors and unnecessary manual work.



**3. Systems & API Integrations**

- Integrate Shopify, eBay, ERP/WMS software, and logistics platforms.

- Work with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, databases, and third-party services.

- Investigate integration possibilities with Chinese logistics systems.

- Improve data synchronization across our existing platforms.



**4. Data & Internal Tools**

- Build tools for reconciling shipping costs and customer invoices.

- Automate imports and exports between spreadsheets and internal portals.

- Improve order, inventory, and billing data accuracy.

- Create reliable internal dashboards and reports.



## Required Skills



**AI Development & GitHub — Essential**

- Strong practical experience with **Cursor IDE**.

- Comfortable with AI-assisted development or "vibe coding."

- Ability to write effective prompts and guide AI agents through coding tasks.

- Experience using GitHub, Git, branches, commits, merges, and pull requests.

- Ability to read, review, debug, and validate AI-generated code.

- Comfortable modifying an existing codebase rather than always starting from scratch.



**Programming & Automation — Essential**

- Working knowledge of Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript.

- Experience with APIs, webhooks, and system integrations.

- Familiarity with SQL, JSON, CSV, and structured data.

- Experience building automations or internal business tools.

- Ability to investigate technical problems independently.



**Preferred Skills**

- Shopify API and e-commerce integrations.

- Next.js, React, and TypeScript.

- n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar automation platforms.

- ERP, WMS, logistics, or inventory management software.

- Google Sheets API and spreadsheet automation.

- Netlify, cloud deployments, and CI/CD workflows.

- Experience with Chinese logistics software such as Mabang or Dianxiaomi.



## Initial Projects



Your first projects may include:



1. **Invoice automation:** Consolidate shipping data from Google Sheets and ERP systems, match it to Shopify orders, and prepare accurate billing records for our customer portal.

2. **ERP integration:** Investigate and improve data exchange between order management, warehouse, and shipping systems.

3. **Operational automation:** Identify repetitive warehouse, logistics, and administrative workflows that can be automated.

4. **Internal software development:** Build and improve tools using Cursor, AI coding agents, and GitHub.



## What We're Looking For



You don't have to know every programming language or framework.



What matters is your ability to **use AI effectively to build reliable, working software**.



We want someone who:

- Can turn an idea into a working prototype.

- Knows how to use Cursor efficiently.

- Understands the code being generated, rather than blindly accepting AI output.

- Can troubleshoot errors without relying entirely on AI.

- Is comfortable working independently with GitHub repositories.

- Tests changes before publishing them.

- Can communicate technical problems to nontechnical colleagues.

- Understands data security, backups, and safe deployment practices.

- Is resourceful, proactive, and eager to learn unfamiliar systems.



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume or portfolio.

2. Examples of applications, automations, or tools you've built using Cursor or other AI coding assistants.

3. Your GitHub profile or sample repositories, if available.

4. A brief explanation of your experience with APIs and automation.

5. Your expected monthly salary in PHP and availability.



**Screening Questions**



1. How do you use Cursor or AI coding tools in your development workflow? Give an example of something you've built.



2. Have you worked with GitHub repositories, branches, and pull requests? Explain your typical workflow.



3. Suppose a company stores customer shipping charges in Google Sheets and order information in an ERP system. How would you build an automation that matches the records, prevents duplicate charges, and prepares data for invoicing?



4. When Cursor generates code that appears to work, how do you verify that it's reliable and safe to deploy?



**We're looking for a practical builder who knows how to combine AI, coding, and automation to solve real business problems.**

title: Experienced DTC Meta Ai Video Editor (ULTRA REALISTIC)
description:
Here is a tailored, high-performance job description designed to attract elite AI video editors and creative specialists capable of executing ultra-realistic product integration, intricate AI UGC, and high-volume direct-response concepts.



QUICK SUMMARY

Daily Output: At least 3 concepts per day (averaging 2 minutes each), including revisions.



Focus: Ultra-high-level direct-response product ads leveraging advanced AI video generation, hyper-realistic AI UGC, and intricate product integration.



Location: Remote



Compensation: $1,500/month flat base retainer + high-performance winning ad bonuses.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an elite, world-class AI Video Editor & Creative Specialist who operates at the absolute cutting edge of artificial intelligence and direct-response advertising.



This role is not for basic prompt-and-pray creators. We need someone who can execute the most intricate, complex AI workflows in the industry—from generating hyper-realistic AI UGC showing products being actively applied, worn, or interacted with, to seamlessly blending synthetic elements into live-action footage so they are entirely indistinguishable from reality.



You understand direct-response psychology, retention editing, pacing, and the nuances of high-converting Meta and TikTok ad creatives. Speed is critical, but realism, physical accuracy, and conversion quality are non-negotiable.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

High-Volume Concept Production: Deliver at least 3 distinct, fully polished ad concepts daily (approx. 2 minutes per video), including all revisions and iterations based on performance feedback.



Ultra-Realistic AI UGC & Product Interaction: Create flawless AI characters and UGC creators that look, move, and speak with human realism. Execute complex interactions such as applying skincare/products, unboxing, wearing items, and handling objects with zero physical artifacts.



Advanced AI Video & B-Roll Generation: Utilize state-of-the-art video models (Runway Gen-3/4, Kling, Luma) to produce cinematic, clean-lighting, texturally accurate b-roll and scene extensions that integrate invisibly into real-world footage.



Character, Voice, & Lip-Sync Mastery: Direct and manage hyper-realistic AI talking heads, precise lip-syncing, emotional delivery, and nuanced accent distinction (British/American).



End-to-End Post-Production: Handle scripting support, prompt engineering, compositing, upscaling (Topaz), sound design, colour grading, pacing, and final export delivery across Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Desktop.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKIC-K (YOUR STACK)

You must already be a power user across most of the following tools:



AI Video: Runway Gen-3 / Gen-4, Kling, Luma Dream Machine, LTX Studio, or equivalent advanced motion models.



Voice / Character: HeyGen, ElevenLabs, D-ID, or custom pipeline equivalents.



Image Generation: Midjourney v6+, Leonardo.ai, Stable Diffusion (ControlNet/IP-Adapter for product consistency).



Editing Suite: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Desktop.



Enhancement: Topaz Video AI.



REQUIREMENTS & STANDARDS

Obsessive Attention to Detail: You must instantly spot and fix distorted fingers, floating objects, unnatural lighting, warping textures, awkward lip-syncing, or dead emotion. If it looks "AI-generated," it doesn't ship.



Direct-Response Fluency: Deep understanding of hooks, visual retention triggers, emotional arcs, and what makes high-ticket or DTC products convert on paid social.



Exceptional Speed & Output: Proven ability to maintain a blistering daily pace (3+ concepts/day at 2 minutes each) without sacrificing technical or visual quality.



Audio & Accent Awareness: Flawless English comprehension with the ability to direct and refine voice deliveries, pacing, and regional accents (UK/US).



COMPENSATION & BONUSES

Base Salary: $1,500 per month



Performance Bonuses:



$200 Bonus: Any winning ad spending over $200/day at a 1.8+ ROAS.



$1,000 Bonus: Any winning ad spending $1,000/day at a 2.0+ ROAS.



HOW TO APPLY

Please provide:



A portfolio or folder showcasing your best AI-assisted video work, product ad creatives, and complex AI UGC.



Direct examples of intricate product interaction/application generated via AI.



A list of the AI tools and versions you currently use or pay for regularly.



Application Requirement:

To prove you have strong attention to detail, start your application or cover letter with the secret word: NEURAL

About PTOE Global Solutions 



PTOE Global Solutions is a business solutions partner helping entrepreneurs, small businesses, and growing organizations overcome operational challenges, strengthen their businesses, and achieve sustainable growth. 



We believe business owners should be able to focus on their vision, customers, and growth opportunities without becoming overwhelmed by the day-to-day complexities of running their organizations.

Our vision is to build lasting relationships with the businesses we serve, becoming a trusted partner in their long-term success. 



As we continue to grow, we are looking for an experienced Managing Director who can lead PGS into its next stage of development.



The Role



We are seeking a strategic, commercially minded, and hands-on Managing Director to take ownership of the leadership, performance, and continued development of PGS. 



This is not a traditional administrative or operations management position. 



We are looking for someone who thinks like a business owner, acts with accountability, and has the leadership capabilities to build an organization that delivers results consistently and independently. 



The Managing Director will be responsible for transforming PGS into a highly effective, scalable, and financially sustainable business solutions organization. 



You will lead a multidisciplinary team, strengthen our management structure, improve operational efficiency, develop organizational capabilities, and ensure we consistently deliver meaningful value to our clients. 



You will work closely with the Founder and business coaching function to translate strategic priorities and client outcomes into organizational capabilities, execution plans, and measurable results. 



Your success will be measured not by how busy the organization is, but by the value it creates, the results it delivers, and its ability to operate effectively without constant oversight. 



 

Responsibilities 



1. Business Leadership & Strategic Execution

Translate the organization's vision and strategic direction into actionable business plans, priorities, and measurable objectives. 



Establish clear accountability across departments, functions, and leadership roles.

Proven experience in problem-solving, decision-making skills and take complete ownership of the entire daily operations. 



2. Operational Excellence & Scalability

Reduce operational dependency on the Founder by empowering managers and team members to make decisions and deliver results.

Ensure internal resources are utilized effectively across multiple clients, projects, and business initiatives. 



Build an operating model capable of supporting a growing portfolio of businesses without proportionally increasing management complexity. 



3. People Leadership & Organizational Development

Evaluate organizational structure, role clarity, capabilities, and performance. 



Ensure the right people are in the right roles, with clear expectations and measurable outcomes. 



Work with Talent Management to strengthen recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and talent development. 



Establish effective leadership meetings, performance reviews, and communication practices. 



Address performance issues proactively and constructively. 



Foster a culture where people take initiative, solve problems, and continuously develop their capabilities. 



4. Client Solutions & Service Delivery 



Ensure PGS consistently delivers high-quality solutions that address real business challenges. 



Work collaboratively with business coaches and client-facing leaders to understand client objectives, commitments, and required outcomes. 



Ensure projects and services are properly planned, resourced, executed, and measured. 



Strengthen service delivery practices to improve client satisfaction, retention, and long-term relationships. 



Identify and resolve delivery challenges before they negatively impact clients. 



Develop repeatable, scalable service offerings while maintaining the flexibility to meet individual client needs. 



Ensure PGS functions as a dependable operating partner for the businesses it supports. 



5. Financial & Commercial Performance 



Take responsibility for operational financial performance, profitability, and resource efficiency. 



Develop and manage operating budgets, forecasts, and financial performance indicators. 



Monitor the profitability and sustainability of service offerings and client engagements. 



Identify opportunities to improve margins, eliminate waste, and increase productivity. 



Collaborate with Growth and Marketing leadership to ensure the organization can support new business opportunities and expansion. 



Contribute to pricing, service packaging, capacity planning, and commercial decisions. 



Balance investment in growth with financial discipline and responsible stewardship of resources. 



6. Systems, Technology & Continuous Improvement 



Champion the effective use of technology, automation, AI, and management systems across PGS. 



Ensure organizational processes are supported by appropriate tools, reporting, and performance dashboards. 



Oversee the adoption and effective use of internal business management platforms. 



Encourage innovation and practical problem-solving across teams. 



Ensure technology investments improve organizational effectiveness and client value rather than introduce unnecessary complexity. 



 



Qualifications

Strong understanding of business operations, financial management, organizational development, and service delivery.

title: QA Validator
description:
Position Overview 



The QA Validator is responsible for validating the accuracy, consistency, and compliance of both Quality Assurance evaluations and KPIs by reviewing customer interactions, verifying Revenue Dispositions, QA markdowns, and identifying process deviations and critical errors. 



The role requires a strong Quality Assurance perspective, solid understanding of data interpretation, and the ability to accurately apply call processes, standards, and QA guidelines. The QA Validator serves as a quality control layer to ensure that evaluations and reported revenue are accurate, objective, and aligned with established standards. 



  



Key Responsibilities 



Validate Calls and QA Evaluations 



Listen to and review customer calls to validate disposition accuracy, QA markdowns and evaluator findings. 



Confirm whether markdowns are supported by actual call evidence. 



Identify incorrect, inconsistent, or unsupported QA findings. 



Ensure evaluations are aligned with approved QA standards and scoring guidelines. 



Apply Quality Assurance Standards 



Maintain a strong QA perspective when evaluating agent performance. 



Master and consistently apply campaign-specific call processes, SOPs, policies, and quality standards. 



Understand the intent and application of individual QA parameters and scoring criteria. 



Identify gaps between the expected process and actual agent behavior. 



Identify Process Deviations and Critical Errors 



Detect deviations from established call processes and procedures. 



Identify compliance issues and critical errors that may impact customers, revenue, or business operations. 



Distinguish between minor process gaps, valid QA markdowns, and critical/fail-level errors. 



Escalate significant or recurring quality issues to the appropriate stakeholders. 



Data Understanding & Interpretation 



Analyze KPI results and operational data to identify trends, patterns, and potential inconsistencies. 



Interpret QA metrics and supporting data to validate whether reported results accurately reflect agent performance. 



Cross-reference KPIs with QA and operational data when necessary. 



Recognize data anomalies that may require further investigation. 



QA & Data Platform Navigation 



Effectively navigate and utilize QA platforms, data platforms, call recording systems, and related tools. 



Locate evaluations, call recordings, scorecards, dispositions, audit results, and supporting data. 



Perform accurate validation across multiple platforms while maintaining data integrity. 



Adapt to platform updates, new QA tools, and changes in evaluation processes. 



Documentation & Reporting 



Document validation findings clearly, objectively, and accurately. 



Report process deviations, compliance concerns, critical errors, and incorrect markdowns. 



Provide evidence-based feedback that can support coaching, calibration, and process improvement. 



Maintain accurate records of validation results and recurring findings. 



Required Competencies 



1. Quality Assurance Perspective 



Strong attention to detail. 



Ability to assess calls objectively and consistently. 



Understands the difference between an actual quality issue and an acceptable variation in agent behavior. 



Able to make evidence-based QA decisions. 



2. Process & Standards Mastery 



Strong knowledge of call flows, SOPs, policies, and QA standards. 



Ability to quickly identify when an agent deviates from the expected process. 



Consistently applies standards without personal bias or assumptions. 



3. Data Understanding & Interpretation 



Comfortable working with QA metrics, reports, KPIs and operational data. 



Able to interpret data and identify trends, inconsistencies, and anomalies. 



Understands how individual call findings can impact overall QA reporting. 



4. Call Listening & Validation 



Strong listening and comprehension skills. 



Able to identify key moments, agent actions, customer intent, and outcomes within a call. 



Capable of validating markdowns against actual call evidence. 



5. Platform Proficiency 



Comfortable navigating multiple systems simultaneously. 



Able to locate and cross-reference information across QA, call recording, CRM, and data platforms. 



Strong computer and technical navigation skills. 



6. Communication & Reporting 



Able to clearly explain why a markdown is valid or invalid. 



Provides concise, factual, and evidence-based findings. 



Can communicate process deviations and critical issues professionally. 



Core Success Measures 



A successful QA Validator should be able to: 



Listen → Understand → Validate → Identify → Document → Report

title: Lead Meta Ads Expert - Lead Gen, Tracking + Organic Social (40-50k)
description:
WHO WE ARE



An Australian marketing agency that gets homeowners to book jobs with trade and home service companies: solar, batteries, air conditioning, electricians, pool builders, roofers and builders. Our clients judge us on one thing: did the phone ring with real jobs. We track every lead from the first tap on an ad to the signed job, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing to fake.



The company name is left out of this post deliberately. Pass the first screen and we will introduce ourselves properly by
 before you ever get on a call with us.



THE SHORT VERSION



We need an experienced Meta advertiser who can carry a client from "just signed" to "leads arriving and being tracked" with no hand holding, then keep improving the results month after month.



You think like a strategist, you set things up like a technician, and you plan content like a social media lead. If you have only ever done one of those three, this is not the role.



WHAT A NORMAL MONTH LOOKS LIKE



When a client signs

- You get into their
 business setup, or build it properly from nothing: Business Manager, ad account, Page, Instagram, billing, partner access

- You install the pixel and the Conversions API, check the events in Events Manager, and make sure browser and server events are not double counted

- You verify the domain and d
 which events Meta should optimise toward

- You connect the lead forms and landing pages to our CRM (GoHighLevel) so every enquiry lands instantly and the follow-up starts on its own

- You set up Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 and clean UTM tagging on their pages

- Sometimes you do this live on a video call while the owner clicks through their own accounts. Patient, clear English matters here



When the ads are running

- You d
 what the client should be selling in the ad: the offer, the promise, the reason to act now

- You plan the angles and hooks, and you test them properly, one change at a time, with enough spend to mean something

- You know when to cut an ad, when to leave it alone, and when to put more money behind it

- You feed real outcomes back to Meta from the CRM (qualified, booked, sold) so the algorithm chases jobs, not form fills

- You build campaign structures that can be copied across several clients in the same trade

- You study the Ad Library and competitors before you guess



On the organic side

- You plan the content for each client's
 and Instagram: themes, formats, a calendar, and the ideas behind each post

- You research what is working in the client's market and turn it into concepts

- You give creative direction to our video and design team. They make it. Posting is automated, so your job is the thinking, not the scheduling



Behind the scenes

- You are comfortable in Meta for Developers: apps, system users, access tokens and permissions

- Webhooks and API documentation do not scare you. You do not need to write code, but you can follow it



Every week

- You report what happened in plain English. Our number is cost per booked job, not cost per click

- If something did not work, you tell us early and explain why

- You present your thinking on calls with Australian business owners



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Years of hands-on Meta lead generation with real budgets, ideally for local service businesses

- A history of results you can actually show us, from real accounts

- Has personally set up the Conversions API and fixed event problems, not just run ads inside an account someone else built

- Has planned organic social content that performed, not just paid ads

- Thinks about the offer before the audience

- Double checks everything. A broken pixel or a lead that never reaches the CRM costs our client money and costs us the client

- Strong written and spoken English

- Curious about AI. We use it everywhere, we pay for your Claude account, and we expect you to learn new tools and workflows quickly



Bonus points: GoHighLevel, Google Ads, Looker Studio, Australian clients, trade or construction experience.



WHY PEOPLE WANT TO WORK WITH US



- Direct access to a founder with roughly 20 years in marketing who works with established multi-million dollar businesses and is deep into AI

- A team of 10+ specialists behind you: video, design, CRM, development and AI. You never have to do everything alone

- Some of the best AI tooling available, built into the way we work

- Quick decisions and real support

- Room to grow into one of the most important people in the business



PAY



PHP 40,000 to 50,000 a month. Where you start depends on the evidence you show us, not on the job titles you have held.



You get a written scorecard for the role on your first day, and we sit down at 60 days to review your work against it.



HOW THE ENGAGEMENT WORKS



- You are an independent contractor, not an employee. You send an invoice and we pay it.

- Your own tax and government contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG) are your responsibility.

- There is no paid leave, sick leave or 13th month pay. We would rather say that now than surprise you later.

- Paid twice monthly in PHP via Wise.

- Hours are 7:00am to 3:30pm Philippine time, Monday to Friday, with some flexibility for client calls in Australian business hours.

- Full time and exclusive. No other agencies or retained clients while you work with us.

- Three month probation, then two weeks written notice from either side.

- Before any offer there is a PAID trial task: diagnose a real ad account, outline a test plan and a content plan, and write up how you would onboard and track a new client. You are paid for it either way.

- You need your own computer, at least 25 Mbps internet, a backup connection and a plan for brownouts.

- You will see client ad accounts and CRMs, so a contractor agreement and an NDA come before any access.



THE INTERVIEW



- Shortlisted applicants get an
 telling them who we are and offering one interview time. Please confirm it in writing, otherwise we release the slot.

- Tell us before the time if you cannot make it and we will reschedule once. No show and no message means we close your application.

- It is a 30 minute screen share. We open a real ad account and a real Events Manager and ask you what you see and what you would do.

- Only claim what you can show us live. Modest but genuine experience is welcome. A claim that falls apart on screen is not.



TO APPLY



The very first line of your application must be: SIGNAL followed by the number of Meta ad accounts you are personally managing right now.



Example: SIGNAL 7



If your application does not start like that, we will not open it. We are telling you this openly because we want people who read carefully.



After that, send us these six things.



1. YOUR CV. As an attachment or a link. A LinkedIn link alone does not count.



2. THE SKILLS CHECK. Copy this list and mark each line with one word. YES = done it on a real client account (name the industry). SOME = understand it but have not done it myself. NO = have not done it. We trust an honest NO far more than a page full of YES.



   1. Diagnosed a struggling ad account in writing before making any changes

   2. Changed only the offer in an ad and measured the effect on lead cost

   3. Built a new client's Meta setup from nothing: Business Manager, ad account, Page, pixel

   4. Installed the Conversions API and confirmed events in Events Manager

   5. Solved duplicate events between the pixel and the Conversions API

   6. Verified a domain inside Business Manager

   7. Sent Meta lead form leads into a CRM in real time

   8. Pushed CRM results (qualified, booked, sold) back into Meta

   9. Created a Meta app and a system user access token

   10. Set up GA4 and Google Tag Manager and checked the events fire

   11. Reused one campaign structure across several clients in the same industry

   12. Planned a month of organic content for a business and measured how it performed

   13. Briefed a video editor or designer on an ad and got it back right first time

   14. Managed five or more ad accounts at once

   15. Ran ads for a trade, home service or construction company

   16. Walked a business owner through their own Meta settings on a live call



3. YOUR BEST TURNAROUND. Pick one account you fixed. Tell us what was going wrong, what you changed first and why you started there, what happened to the results, and what you would do differently today. Add a screenshot if you can. We care most about your reasoning.



4. YOUR TRACKING BUILD. Pick one client. Explain how the pixel, the Conversions API, the forms and the CRM were wired together, what went wrong along the way, and how you proved it all worked.



5. YOUR CONTENT THINKING. Imagine an Australian air conditioning installer with a quiet
 page and no content plan. Give us three post ideas for next month and one paid ad angle, and tell us why each one would work.



6. YOUR RATE AND YOUR
.

- What you earn per month now in PHP, and what you need to work with us full time and exclusively.

- The
 address we should contact you on.



Please write it yourself. Using AI to tidy your spelling is fine. If AI writes the answers for you, we will know within a few minutes of the interview, because we will put a live account in front of you and ask what you would do.

title: eCommerce and Admin Assistant
description:
Ecommerce Product Content and PIM Assistant

USUALLY 10–15 HOURS PER WEEK, DEPENDING ON WORKLOAD



About the role

Majority Audio is a UK consumer electronics business selling audio products through major retailers and online channels. We’re looking for an experienced, detail-focused assistant to help keep our product catalogue accurate and improve how our products are presented across retailer websites.

This role combines product content writing, catalogue administration and retailer follow-up. It suits someone who can write clear English copy, work carefully with product data and keep requests moving without needing close supervision.



What you’ll do



Retailer product pages and awards

• Review our product listings on major retailer websites and record where product awards and approvals are shown, including Which? awards and Dolby certification.

• Identify retailer content fields, image areas or other approved ways to display these items.

• Prepare and submit requests to retailers to add approved awards or approvals to product pages.

• Where a retailer has no dedicated field, check its requirements for infographic-style content and upload approved artwork where permitted.

• Track each request through to implementation, recording the product, retailer, date submitted, response and live page link.

• Use only supplied, approved award wording and artwork. Raise questions before making a claim or changing an asset.

PIM and product-data requests

• Monitor a dedicated
 address for product-data change requests from the team.

• Check that requests are clear and supported by the supplied source information, then update the PIM and record what changed.

• Ask for clarification where instructions conflict, information is missing or a requested claim cannot be verified.

• Keep product records accurate across SKUs and variants, with careful checks on specifications, names and product identifiers.



Monitor and Administer a sales inbox

• Check for incoming sales orders, and ensure they conform to our standards (minimum quantities etc) 

• Acknowledge receipt of orders in a timely and professional way 

• Answer basic questions about orders with the help of our standard policies. 

• Adhere to an SLA based around UK working hours (Mon-Fri
). You will not be required to work these hours, but you must be able to meet the target time limits. 



New product and retailer set-ups

• Populate product set-up sheets and retailer forms using the current PIM data.

• Check each completed sheet against the source record before returning it.

• Leave unsupported fields blank or flag them for review rather than guessing.



Product copy

• Write, edit and proofread concise product descriptions, feature bullets and other catalogue copy.

• Make the copy clear and persuasive while keeping every product claim supported by approved product information.

• Follow the requested language, tone, character limits and field requirements for each retailer.



What good work looks like

• Product information and copy are accurate, consistent and ready to use with minimal correction.

• Retailer requests are logged and followed through, with clear records of what is live and what is still outstanding.

• Set-up sheets are complete wherever the source data allows, with gaps clearly identified.

title: PYTHON / DJANGO DEVELOPER — AUTO PARTS DATA PLATFORM
description:
ABOUT THE PROJECT



AftermarketScout is a B2B platform for the US automotive aftermarket. Auto

parts shops and retailers use it to search a unified catalog of millions of

parts, check live inventory and pricing across dozens of distributors, and

push products and orders into their own stores and shop-management systems.



The backend is a Django application (Python 3.11, PostgreSQL, Redis,

Meilisearch, Docker) with roughly 30 live distributor integrations and data

pipelines that ingest, normalize, and de-duplicate millions of part records.

It is a real production system with paying customers, not a greenfield toy

project.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY WORK ON



- Building and maintaining integrations with parts distributors: REST and

  SOAP APIs, SFTP/CSV and XML feeds, EDI X12 order documents, and a few

  sites that need careful HTTP scraping with sessions, cookies, and proxies.

- Data pipelines: ingesting supplier catalogs, normalizing part numbers,

  matching parts across suppliers, cleaning up duplicates, backfilling

  images and specs.

- Vehicle fitment work (ACES/VCdb-style data) so a shop searching for their

  truck gets the right parts.

- REST API endpoints for the web frontend, plus Meilisearch index work for

  catalog search and filtering.

- Writing the one-off and scheduled Django management commands that run

  these jobs, and making them restartable and safe to re-run.

- Debugging production issues: a supplier changes their feed, a sync drifts,

  a query gets slow. You will be expected to dig in and find the cause.



REQUIREMENTS



- 3+ years of professional Python, with at least 2 years on Django.

- Strong SQL and PostgreSQL: you can read a slow query, add the right index,

  and know why a join over millions of rows is a bad idea.

- Real experience consuming third-party APIs and messy data feeds, including

  pagination, rate limits, retries, and partial failures.

- Comfortable with Git, code review, and Docker.

- You write tests for logic that matters and you check your own work before

  saying it is done.

- Able to read an existing large codebase and follow its patterns instead of

  rewriting things your own way.

- Written English good enough to explain a tricky data problem in Slack

  clearly. Most of our communication is written.

- Reliable internet and your own computer.



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



- Automotive, e-commerce, ERP, or marketplace/catalog data experience.

- Meilisearch, Elasticsearch, or other search engine experience.

- Playwright/Selenium or other scraping experience against sites with bot

  protection.

- EDI (X12 850/855/856/810) exposure.

- Experience working alongside AI coding tools day to day.



HOW WE WORK



- Fully remote, paid monthly.

- Core overlap: you should be reachable for at least 4 hours between

  9:00 AM and 6:00 PM Philippine time; the rest of your hours are flexible.

- Written-first: clear tickets, short async updates, one call a week if

  needed.

- I care about correctness over speed. This system touches real inventory

  and real orders, so "it ran without an error" is not the same as "it is

  right." Say when you are unsure instead of guessing.

- Long-term role. If this works out, it is ongoing work, not a one-off

  project.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send a generic application. I read every one that follows

these instructions and ignore the rest.



Start your message with the word SPARKPLUG so I know you read this post.



Then answer these four questions:



Also include:

- A link to your GitHub, GitLab, or any code you can share.

- Your years with Python and with Django.

- Your expected monthly rate in USD and your available hours per week.



Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test task (around 2-3 hours, paid

regardless of outcome) on a small, isolated piece of real work.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR — ECOMMERCE META ADS

Remote | Full-time | $900–$1,500 USD depending on experience



ABOUT MHI MEDIA



MHI Media is a performance marketing agency helping ambitious e-commerce and DTC brands grow. We create and test the ads that drive sales for brands operating at serious scale.



Our creative team is made up of editors, designers, strategists and pod leads working together across a large portfolio of brands. We produce a high volume of creative, learn from performance data and improve quickly — so this is a great environment for someone who wants to become genuinely excellent at advertising, not just make videos that look nice.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a high-quality Video Editor who understands that a paid social ad has one job: earn attention, communicate the idea clearly and move the viewer towards action.



You will edit e-commerce video ads for Meta from briefs, scripts, references and raw assets. You will work closely with creative strategists and pod leads, submit work for internal QA, respond to feedback and keep improving your output over time.



This role is not for someone who needs to be chased through every step. We want an editor who can understand a brief, make strong creative decisions, check their own work and deliver reliably.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Edit e-commerce video ads for Meta, generally using UGC, product footage, stock, screen recordings, founder content, AI-generated assets and b-roll

- Build strong opening hooks and produce thoughtful variations from winning creative

- Create clear, well-paced edits with effective captions, text overlays, sound design, music and light motion graphics

- Follow the brief and reference closely while adapting the edit to the product, audience and brand

- Make sure visuals, voiceover, captions, claims, offers, product details and brand assets all match the brief

- Submit organised work through our production workflow and meet agreed deadlines

- Apply QA feedback accurately rather than repeating the same mistakes

- Repurpose winning concepts into new hooks, edits, lengths, placements and aspect ratios

- Communicate early when a brief, asset or deadline is unclear or blocked

- Study performance feedback and use it to make future creative stronger



WHAT GREAT PERFORMANCE LOOKS LIKE



- Your first version is already clean, considered and close to the brief

- You understand why a hook, cut, pause, caption or visual is being used — not just how to add it

- You catch spelling, pacing, safe-zone, branding, continuity and audio issues before submitting

- You can take direct feedback without becoming defensive and implement it properly

- You are reliable: deadlines are met, blockers are raised early and tasks do not disappear

- Your work gets better as you learn what performs for different audiences and brands

- Strategists and pod leads trust you with increasingly important work



WHO WE WANT



We want operators, not talkers.



You will probably do well here if you are:



- Performance-minded: interested in what makes people stop, watch and buy

- Detail-obsessed: you notice the one typo, wrong product, weak cut or incorrect logo before anyone else does

- A strong brief reader: you follow direction precisely and ask questions when something is unclear

- Coachable: you actively want detailed feedback and use it to improve

- Proactive: you look for the next useful action instead of waiting to be chased

- Fast but not careless: you can work at volume without lowering your standards

- Commercially curious: you want to understand the customer, offer, audience and creative strategy behind the edit

- A clear communicator: you can explain your decisions and flag problems early

- Comfortable working remotely with a distributed team and shared deadlines



This probably will not be the right role for you if you only want to make cinematic edits, dislike performance-driven work, ignore briefs, take feedback personally or need constant supervision.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of professional video editing experience

- A portfolio showing e-commerce, direct-response, paid social, UGC or comparable advertising work

- Strong skills in Premiere Pro, CapCut or a similar professional editing tool

- Working knowledge of motion graphics, captions, sound design, music and basic colour correction

- Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, retention and vertical video formats

- Professional written and spoken English

- Reliable computer, internet connection and availability for full-time remote work

- Ability to work within a structured workflow and meet deadlines consistently



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience editing Meta ads for DTC or e-commerce brands

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, ElevenLabs, Runway, Descript or similar

WHAT WE OFFER

We are looking for an experienced B2B outbound cold caller and appointment setter.



This is a pure HUNTER role.



There are ZERO leads provided to you.



You will be responsible for researching your target market, building your own prospect lists, identifying the correct decision-makers, cold calling businesses and generating qualified appointments for our Australian Sales Team.



If your experience is primarily answering inbound calls, working supplied leads or calling warm databases, this role is not for you.

From there, you own the process.

* Researching businesses within our target markets.

Monday to Friday

title: Senior B2B Outbound Sales & Appointment Setter – Proven Sales Hunter
description:
Senior B2B Outbound Sales & Appointment Setter – Proven Sales Hunter

Full Time | Monday–Friday | 9:00am–5:00pm Perth, Western Australia Time

Minimum 5 Years Proven B2B Outbound Sales Experience Required



*Please do not contact anyone from the company outside of this platform. Doing so, will disqualify your application”



QPC Group is an established Australian office technology company providing Managed Print Services, printers and photocopiers, VoIP phone systems and other business technology solutions.

We are looking for a highly experienced, senior B2B outbound salesperson and appointment setter with a proven track record of success.

This is NOT an entry-level position.

We want someone who knows how to pick up the phone, confidently speak with Australian businesses, build rapport, uncover opportunities and consistently book qualified appointments for our Australian Sales Team.

We are looking for a genuine sales professional who knows how to have a conversation, not someone who simply reads from a script.

Your Calling Structure

Your daily calling activity will consist of approximately:

• 10% – Supplied Leads: Contacting leads provided by QPC Group.

• 30% – Warm Database Calling: Working through our existing database, reconnecting with businesses and identifying new opportunities.

• 60% – Cold Calling: Calling businesses from prospect lists supplied by QPC Group, identifying the correct decision-makers and generating new business opportunities.

Prospect lists will be provided. However, you must have the research skills and experience to identify the correct people to contact.

The majority of this role involves genuine outbound cold calling. You must enjoy prospecting and be comfortable creating opportunities.

What You Will Do

• Work through supplied prospect lists, warm databases and sales leads.

• Use LinkedIn and other online tools to research businesses and identify decision-makers.

• Understand which job titles to target depending on the organisation.

• Identify IT Managers, IT Directors, Business Owners, General Managers, Procurement Officers, Office Managers and other relevant decision-makers.

• Research names, job titles, company details and contact information before calling.

• Confidently cold call Australian businesses.

• Ask for decision-makers by name wherever possible.

• Professionally navigate receptionists, personal assistants and other gatekeepers.

• Build rapport and have genuine, engaging business conversations.

• Ask intelligent questions to understand the prospect's current situation.

• Uncover pain points, frustrations, inefficiencies and potential business requirements.

• Identify genuine sales opportunities and buying signals.

• Confidently handle objections and keep conversations moving.

• Generate qualified leads and book appointments directly for our Australian Sales Team.

• Maintain accurate prospect information and call records.

• Follow up with prospects and progress opportunities.

• Consistently work towards agreed sales activity and appointment targets.

The Sales Skills & Personality We're Looking For

We need someone who is a natural communicator, confident conversationalist and experienced sales hunter.

You must know how to talk to people, build trust and turn conversations into opportunities.

You should be able to:

• Build rapport naturally: Make people comfortable speaking with you, even when you've called them completely cold.

• Hold genuine conversations: Speak naturally and confidently without sounding robotic, scripted or overly rehearsed.

• Get past gatekeepers: Know how to professionally navigate receptionists and personal assistants to reach decision-makers.

• Ask the right questions: Know how to encourage prospects to open up about their business.

• Uncover pain points: Identify frustrations, unnecessary costs, inefficiencies and problems our solutions may help resolve.

• Listen and think on your feet: Adapt your conversation based on what the prospect tells you.

• Be direct and confident: Get to the point, explain why you're calling and respect the prospect's time.

• Lead the conversation: Guide discussions towards identifying opportunities and booking appointments without being pushy.

• Handle objections: Confidently respond when someone says they're not interested, already have a supplier or are too busy.

• Recognise opportunities: Identify buying signals, contract renewals, dissatisfaction with existing suppliers and genuine business needs.

• Close for the appointment: Know when and how to confidently secure the next step.

We don't want script readers. We want salespeople who know how to talk to people.

High Call Activity & Appointment Targets

You must be experienced and comfortable with high-volume outbound calling.

We expect you to be accustomed to making 100+ calls on days when prospects are difficult to reach, but equally understand that a productive day might involve only 40 calls because you've spent more time having quality conversations with decision-makers.

We don't measure success purely by how many numbers you dial.

Your target is a minimum of 30 qualified sales appointments per month for our Australian Sales Team.

That's approximately 7–8 qualified appointments per week.

We value meaningful conversations, uncovered opportunities and genuine appointments.

We want someone who knows how to balance call volume with conversation quality and consistently deliver results.

You Must Have – Non-Negotiable Requirements

• Minimum 5 years of proven B2B outbound sales and cold-calling experience.

• A demonstrated track record of successfully booking qualified sales appointments.

• Extensive experience speaking with business owners and senior decision-makers.

• Strong LinkedIn research skills and the ability to identify the correct contacts.

• Experience working with both cold prospect lists and warm sales databases.

• Excellent spoken English, clear pronunciation and professional telephone communication.

• Confidence speaking with Australian business customers.

• Advanced rapport-building, questioning and objection-handling skills.

• Proven ability to navigate gatekeepers and reach decision-makers.

• Strong listening skills and the ability to hold natural, engaging conversations.

• Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

• A history of achieving or exceeding sales and appointment-setting targets.

• Resilience, persistence and a genuine passion for outbound sales.

Experience selling Managed Print Services, photocopiers, IT services, telecommunications or other B2B technology solutions would be highly regarded.

Please only apply if you have extensive, proven experience doing this type of work.

Working Hours

This is a full-time position:

Monday to Friday

9:00am – 5:00pm Perth, Western Australia time

You must be available for the full shift and have a reliable internet connection, suitable working environment and backup arrangements for power or internet outages.

IMPORTANT – Voice Recording Required

Because this is a telephone-based sales position, your voice recording is an essential part of your application.

Please record yourself delivering the following as though you were speaking to a real Australian business prospect:

"Hi, my name is [YOUR NAME] from QPC Group. We are an office technology company. We provide managed print services and VoIP phone systems. I'd love to know which one's your biggest pain point in your office to see how we can help you today."

Don't rush through it or simply read the words.

We want to hear your natural telephone voice, confidence, energy, spoken English and ability to sound conversational rather than scripted.

Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

How to Apply – ALL Requirements Are Mandatory

Your application MUST have the following subject line:

Outbound Sales Genius

Please include:

1. Voice Recording: Your recording using the script provided above.

2. Previous Sales Experience: A summary of your minimum 5 years of B2B outbound cold-calling and appointment-setting experience.

3. Proven Sales Results: Details of your previous sales achievements, including average outbound calls per day, qualified appointments booked per month and performance against targets.

4. LinkedIn Research Experience: Explain your experience using LinkedIn to identify decision-makers, their job titles and contact information.

5. CV/Resume: Your current CV showing your relevant employment history and previous sales positions.

6. Three Genuine, Contactable Professional References – MANDATORY: You MUST provide three references from previous sales roles, preferably direct sales managers, supervisors or employers.

For each reference, include:

o Full name

o Job title

o Company name

o Contact phone number

o
 address

o Your working relationship with that person

These must be genuine professional references who have directly supervised or managed your sales performance and are willing to speak with us.

We will contact references directly to verify your experience, sales results, appointment-setting ability, work ethic and reliability.

References that cannot be independently verified or contacted will not meet this requirement.

7. Reason for Leaving: Explain why you are looking to leave your current position, or why you left your most recent sales role.

8. Internet & Power Backup: Confirm your internet speeds and explain your backup plan for power or internet outages.

9. Working Hours Confirmation: Confirm you can work Monday–Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm Perth, Western Australia time.

10 send through your DISC profile

Minimum Apply Points: 3

Applications using fewer than 3 Apply Points will not be considered.

Experienced Sales Professionals Only

We are looking for a senior B2B outbound salesperson who has already proven they can consistently generate qualified sales appointments.

You must be comfortable making 100+ calls when necessary, know how to turn 40 calls into a productive day through meaningful conversations and have the ability to consistently book 30 qualified appointments per month.

You must be confident, conversational, direct and capable of building rapport, navigating gatekeepers, uncovering pain points and securing appointments.

If you cannot demonstrate at least 5 years of successful B2B outbound sales experience, provide three genuine professional references and submit a voice recording, please do not apply.

If you're a proven sales hunter with the confidence, experience and results to back it up, we'd like to hear from you.
